items.title: 〈焦點股〉富驊業務多點開花2027年營運看旺 跳空漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Fu Hua's Business Blossoms Across Multiple Segments, 2027 Outlook Strong, Gaps Up to Limit Up
paras: 富驊(5465-TW)旗下高密度硬碟儲存系統、HPC伺服器、AI高速網路設備及水冷分歧管等業務逐步發酵，再加上泰國廠明年投產挹注，看好明年營收獲利跳增，激勵富驊今(21)日股價表現亮眼，跳空漲停。
富驊早盤即跳空漲停，鎖住29.35元，飛越年線，排隊委買單超過1000張，成交量則約600張。三大法人雖上周無太多著墨，不過仍連續5個交易日買超，合計買超67張。
富驊指出，高密度硬碟儲存系統訂單能見度看至2029年；HPC伺服器斬獲北美一線電腦品牌廠訂單，明年第一季將量產；網通產品上，最新世代1.6T傳輸速度交換器產品，明年第一季開始出貨給北美一線AI廠商；光通訊的光模組產品，預計明年量產；水冷散熱關鍵零組件部分，目前分歧管(Manifold)專案已進入客戶送驗及驗證階段。
除產品展望正面，富驊於泰國建置完整機櫃生產能力，預計明年投產，目前也已取得HPC客戶海外生產及確認，屆時可望帶來營收貢獻。
paras_en: Fu Hua (5465‑TW) sees its high‑density hard‑disk storage systems, HPC servers, AI high‑speed networking equipment, and water‑cooling manifolds gradually gaining traction. With a new plant in Thailand slated to start production next year, the company expects a sharp jump in revenue and profit, prompting its stock to surge dramatically and hit the limit‑up price today (the 21st).

The stock opened with a gap‑up limit‑up, locking in at NT$29.35, soaring above its yearly moving average. Over 1,000 buy orders queued on the bid side, while trading volume was about 600 shares. Although the three major institutional investors did not comment much last week, they have been net buyers for five consecutive trading days, buying a total of 67 lots.

Fu Hua noted that orders for its high‑density hard‑disk storage systems are visible through 2029. The HPC server line has secured an order from a top North American computer brand, with mass production slated for the first quarter of next year. In networking, the latest‑generation 1.6‑Tbps switch will begin shipping to a leading North American AI company in Q1 2025. Its optical communication modules are expected to enter mass production next year, and the water‑cooling manifold project is now in the customer testing and verification stage.

Beyond product outlooks, Fu Hua is building a full‑scale rack‑mount production line in Thailand, expected to commence operations next year. The company has also secured overseas production confirmation from an HPC customer, which should contribute to revenue once the plant is up and running.

items.title: 美軍要動手了？五角大廈「披薩指數」飆升
items.title_en: US Military About to Act? Pentagon “Pizza Index” Soars
paras: 美國駐中東多國大使館19日（周六）發布安全警示，稱當前安全環境出現不可預見的升級風險，同日美國「披薩指數」追蹤網站發布的數據顯示，五角大廈附近的披薩店當天訂單數激增。
「披薩指數」追蹤網站連續發帖，稱五角大廈旁最近的披薩店於18日22時和19日17時訂單激增，客流量均顯著高於往日相同時段。
「披薩指數」通過追蹤五角大廈附近披薩店的訂單數推測美國國防部是否加班，藉此預測美國軍事行動。在「沙漠風暴」、美軍空襲伊朗核設施等軍事行動前，五角大廈附近披薩店曾出現訂單激增的情況。
美國駐巴林、阿曼、阿聯、沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達、科威特、約旦、以色列、黎巴嫩、伊拉克等國使館19日發布安全警示，稱中東安全環境依然複雜，面臨不可預見的升級風險。
據美國《Axios》等媒體報導，當天晚上美國總統川普縮短度假行程，提前一天從度假地戴維營返回白宮。
據美國《CNN》報導，川普在戴維營評估了打擊葉門叛軍胡塞的各項方案，外界認為「披薩指數」飆升可能與此有關。
paras_en: The U.S. embassies in several Middle Eastern countries issued a security alert on Saturday the 19th, warning that the current security environment carries an unpredictable risk of escalation. On the same day, data from the U.S. “Pizza Index” tracking site showed a sharp surge in orders at pizza shops near the Pentagon.

The “Pizza Index” tracking site posted repeatedly, noting that the nearest pizza shop to the Pentagon saw order spikes at 10 p.m. on the 18th and again at 5 p.m. on the 19th, with foot traffic significantly higher than usual for those time slots.

The “Pizza Index” infers whether the Department of Defense is pulling overtime by monitoring order volumes at nearby pizza restaurants, using the metric to forecast U.S. military actions. Similar order surges have preceded operations such as “Desert Storm” and U.S. air strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities.

U.S. embassies in Bahrain, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and Iraq released a security alert on the 19th, stating that the Middle‑East security environment remains complex and faces an unpredictable risk of escalation.
According to U.S. media outlets such as Axios, that evening President Donald Trump cut short his vacation, returning to the White House a day early from his retreat at Camp David.
CNN reported that Trump evaluated various options for striking the Houthi rebels in Yemen while at Camp David, and observers think the surge in the “Pizza Index” may be linked to that assessment.

items.title: 政院推動桃竹苗大矽谷計畫 國產苗栗廠擁利基挹注業績動能
items.title_en: Government Pushes Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan; Domestic Miaoli Plant Gains Niche to Boost Revenue Momentum
paras: 全球AI浪潮來襲，持續推升半導體產業鏈建廠需求，也帶動桃竹苗西部科技廊帶快速成形。混凝土大廠國產(2504-TW)苗栗廠擁有科技行控與大量澆築高供應力，隨著「桃竹苗大矽谷計畫」陸續推動，未來可望搶攻AI科技建廠與房建商機，業績持續穩健成長。
行政院積極推動「桃竹苗大矽谷計畫」，苗栗作為西部科技廊帶的重要節點，規劃竹南科學園區及其東側、頭份交流道周邊，以及後龍科學產業園區為重點開發區；近期也預計在苗栗市解編15.15公頃公保地，釋出8.8公頃住宅與商業區，承接竹科外溢人口與生活機能，帶動大矽谷高科技生活圈的房市供給。
國產苗栗廠位於銅鑼鄉，擁有科技行控與大量澆築高供應力，過去供應銅鑼科學園區八成科技建廠，包括富田電機、太平洋醫材、盟立自動化、億光電子、達邁科技、日商福吉米、台灣納美仕、力積電等科技大廠。
其中，力積電銅鑼新廠混凝土需求達30萬立方米，由苗栗廠主力供應，主體結構採用6,000磅高強度混凝土，並因地基厚實採用國產建材巨積混凝土，協助大型廠房快速建廠。如今該廠已由全球記憶體大廠美光收購，作為擴充DRAM產能的重要基地。
近期，國產苗栗廠也供應聯發科資料數據中心興建，該資料數據中心因應邊緣AI與雲端AI解決方案研發需求，以綠建築最高等級鑽石級規格打造，預計分三期建置。第一期主體結構採用國產建材6,000磅高強度混凝土，總需求約2.5萬立方米，已於今年5月落成啟用。此外，聯詠未來也規劃在銅科興建運算中心，美光則計畫擴建二期廠區，混凝土需求上看12萬立方米，均為國產苗栗廠積極爭取的目標。
科技建廠效應持續擴散，也帶動苗栗房建市場升溫，目前以後龍高鐵特區、苗栗市、銅鑼及公館等地最受矚目。後龍高鐵特區方面，國產苗栗廠供應包括「苗栗全樂齡居宅」、「傳家寶」系列、「高鐵名邸」1至3期、「新站締寶2」及「寶得新幹線」等指標建案。其中，名軒開發在後龍市區推出基地2570坪造鎮型新案，規劃三棟地下3層、地上15層建築，總戶數453戶，混凝土需求4.5萬立方米，也由國產苗栗廠供應。
苗栗市方面，國產苗栗廠則供應「栗都心悅」、「志聯玥華」、「昊翰」、「瀧淳NO.3」、「輕井澤12-星居」、「昇雲探花」等指標建案。隨著聯發科、美光等科技大廠進駐，銅鑼周邊房市也熱絡，包括興建中的「溢家City One」、「銅科芳華」等建案，同樣由國產苗栗廠供應。
隨著「桃竹苗大矽谷計畫」推動，後龍科學產業園區將成為苗栗廠未來重要布局區域；竹南、頭份則主要由國產新竹廠供應，但苗栗廠也可協力支援，展現區域聯防優勢。
paras_en: The global AI wave is driving up demand for semiconductor‑industry construction, rapidly shaping a western Taiwan tech corridor across Taoyuan, Hsinchu and Miaoli. Domestic Concrete (2504‑TW) Miaoli plant, with its advanced process control and high‑capacity pouring capability, is poised to capture AI‑related factory and building projects as the “Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan” rolls out, keeping its earnings on a steady growth path.

The Executive Yuan is actively advancing the “Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan.” Miaoli, a key node of the western tech corridor, will focus on developing the Zhunan Science Park and its eastern side, the Toufen interchange area, and the Houlong Science Industrial Park. In the near term, about 15.15 ha of public‑owned land in Miaoli City will be re‑zoned, releasing 8.8 ha for residential and commercial use to accommodate spill‑over population and amenities from Hsinchu Science Park, fueling housing supply for the high‑tech lifestyle zone.

Domestic’s Miaoli plant is located in Tongluo Township and boasts advanced process control and high‑volume concrete pouring capacity. Historically it has supplied roughly 80 % of the concrete for technology factories in the Tongluo Science Park, serving major firms such as Futian Electric, Pacific Medical Devices, Mingtai Automation, Everlight Electronics, Dami Technology, Japan’s Fujimi, Taiwan Nami, and Powerchip Semiconductor.

Powerchip Semiconductor’s new Tongluo plant requires 300,000 m³ of concrete, primarily sourced from the Miaoli plant. The main structure uses 6,000‑psi high‑strength concrete and, because of the solid foundation, employs Domestic’s “Juchih” concrete, enabling rapid construction of the large facility. The plant has since been acquired by global memory leader Micron as a key DRAM capacity expansion site.

Recently, Domestic’s Miaoli plant also supplied concrete for MediaTek’s data‑center construction. The center, built to support edge‑AI and cloud‑AI R&D, is being erected to the highest “Diamond” green‑building standard in three phases. Phase 1, using Domestic’s 6,000‑psi concrete, calls for about 25,000 m³ and was completed and commissioned in May this year. In addition, Novatek plans a computing center in Tongluo, and Micron is eyeing a Phase 2 expansion requiring roughly 120,000 m³ of concrete—both projects are actively pursued by the Miaoli plant.

The tech‑construction boom is heating Miaoli’s housing market, with the Houlong High‑Speed Rail zone, Miaoli City, Tongluo and Gongguan drawing the most attention. In the Houlong HSR zone, Domestic supplies projects such as “Miaoli All‑Ages Residence,” the “Family Treasure” series, “High‑Speed Rail Residences” Phases 1‑3, “New Station Treasure 2,” and “Bao‑De High‑Speed Line.” Notably, Ming‑Xuan Development’s 2,570‑ping town‑type project in downtown Houlong, featuring three underground and 15 above‑ground floors with 453 units, requires 45,000 m³ of concrete from Domestic’s Miaoli plant.

In Miaoli City, Domestic provides concrete for flagship projects like “Li‑Du Heart‑Joy,” “Zhi‑Lian Yue‑Hua,” “Hao‑Han,” “Long‑Jun NO.3,” “Karuizawa 12‑Star Residence,” and “Sheng‑Yun Tan‑Hua.” With MediaTek, Micron and other tech giants moving in, the surrounding Tongluo housing market is also bustling, including under‑construction projects such as “Yi‑Jia City One” and “Tongluo Fang‑Hua,” also supplied by the Miaoli plant.

As the “Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan” advances, the Houlong Science Industrial Park will become a key future focus for the Miaoli plant. While Zhunan and Toufen will mainly be served by Domestic’s Hsinchu plant, the Miaoli facility can also provide support, showcasing the regional collaborative advantage.

items.title: 主動式ETF新人周漲幅榜出爐 00411A勁揚逾4%奪冠
items.title_en: Active ETF Newcomer Weekly Gain Rankings Released: 00411A Soars Over 4% to Claim the Top Spot
paras: 台股在國際利率不確定性趨緩及AI題材帶動下震盪走高，主動式ETF也受到激勵普遍皆有好的表現。其中，今年以來掛牌的19檔主動式ETF「新人」中，以主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)近一周股價漲幅表現最佳，在19檔新人中以唯一超過4%的漲幅表現，拿下周漲幅冠軍，同時也是上櫃外資買超首選。
觀察主動式ETF今年掛牌新人近一周股價漲幅表現，前五名依序為：主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)4.22%、主動富邦台灣龍耀(00405A-TW)3.26%、主動安聯台灣(00993A-TW)2.59%、主動兆豐台灣豐收(00996A-TW)2.48%、主動永豐科技趨勢(00410A-TW)1.94%。
00411A上周亦獲得外資資金挹注，買超數達5.4萬張，位居上櫃買超第一名！反映市場資金對其投資主軸與後市表現的關注度升溫。另外，00411A更在上周五收在10.13元創下股價新高後，今(21)開盤持續上攻挑戰新高，盤中最高價達10.22元。
展望後市，主動統一前沿科技ETF經理人郭智偉表示，近期通膨變化除受到油價波動影響，也反映經濟維持良性循環下的需求支撐，以及AI投資擴大所帶來的成長動能。整體而言，美國經濟仍維持正向成長，企業獲利維持雙位數成長；隨AI伺服器新品預計自第四季起逐步放量出貨，市場對企業獲利的預估仍有上修機會。
郭智偉進一步表示，短線上總體環境與市場情緒仍可能受到消息面干擾，但企業基本面尚穩健，長期股市表現仍將以獲利成長為主要依歸。AI仍是驅動科技產業與資本市場的重要趨勢，後續將持續關注AI基礎建設、AI軟體、資產代幣化、自動駕駛、太空經濟與量子運算等主題的技術進展及投資機會。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks rose amid easing international interest‑rate uncertainty and AI‑related themes, and active ETFs were broadly buoyed, delivering solid performance. Among the 19 active‑ETF newcomers listed this year, the Active Uni‑Frontier Technology ETF (00411A‑TW) posted the best weekly price gain, the only one to exceed a 4% rise, earning the weekly gain champion title and becoming the top pick for foreign investors on the OTC market.

Looking at the weekly price gains of active‑ETF newcomers listed this year, the top five were: Active Uni‑Frontier Technology (00411A‑TW) up 4.22%, Active Fubon Taiwan Dragon Shine (00405A‑TW) up 3.26%, Active Allianz Taiwan (00993A‑TW) up 2.59%, Active Mega‑Fong Taiwan Harvest (00996A‑TW) up 2.48%, and Active Yong‑Feng Technology Trend (00410A‑TW) up 1.94%.

00411A also attracted foreign capital last week, with a net purchase of 54,000 shares, ranking first in net foreign buying on the OTC market. This reflects growing market interest in its investment focus and future performance. Moreover, after closing at a new high of NT$10.13 on Friday, the ETF opened on the 21st continuing its upward push, reaching an intraday high of NT$10.22.

Looking ahead, ETF manager Guo Zhi‑wei said recent inflation changes are influenced by oil‑price swings and reflect demand support under a healthy economic cycle, as well as growth momentum from expanding AI investments. Overall, the U.S. economy remains on a positive growth path, with corporate earnings still posting double‑digit growth; with new AI server models expected to ramp up shipments from Q4 onward, market earnings forecasts may still be revised upward.

Guo added that short‑term market sentiment could still be swayed by news flow, but corporate fundamentals remain solid, and long‑term market performance will continue to be driven by earnings growth. AI remains a key catalyst for the technology sector and capital markets, and the team will keep monitoring developments and investment opportunities in AI infrastructure, AI software, asset tokenization, autonomous driving, space economy, and quantum computing.

items.title: 群益：美中科技戰升級 這些族群添台供應鏈成長動能
items.title_en: Quanta: US-China Tech War Escalates, These Sectors Boost Taiwan Supply Chain Growth Momentum
paras: 群益金鼎證券舉辦「美中競逐下的AI算力新局論壇」時指出，隨著中國AI大模型加速追趕，美中科技戰從模型能力延伸至晶片、算力、高速傳輸、能源建設與應用生態，帶動新一波產業投資機會，看2026年是「代理式AI元年」，晶圓代工、先進封裝、高階載板和矽光子等環節持續升級，為台灣供應鏈增添成長動能。
群益投顧說明，美國持續以先進晶片、算力和平台生態鞏固AI優勢，中國則加快自主供應鏈與基礎建設布局，補強整體算力生態系。
政策面上，中國將「人工智慧+」提升至國家戰略層級，加速建設新型電網、算力網和新一代通信網「三新網」，相關投資規模上看人民幣10兆元，為AI基礎建設與自主供應鏈發展提供支撐。
而龐大基建投資也為能源、傳輸與關鍵零組件帶來新商機；由於AI資料中心全天候運轉，推升電力與儲能需求，寧德時代等業者加快儲能與鈉電池布局；算力密度提升則帶動特種光纖及800G、1.6T高階光收發模組成長，中際旭創、長飛光纖光纜等業者備受關注。
在材料端，建滔積層板、勝宏科技分別布局銅箔基板、高階HDI與多層PCB，反映中國供應鏈自主化進程。
群益投顧進一步指出，硬體競逐之外，隨著大型模型能力差距縮小，產業焦點正轉向應用生態與企業導入。能整合工作流程、資料與辦公系統的企業級AI Agent，因具使用黏著度與商業化潛力，正推動AI從「模型能力」走向「應用變現」。
因此，今年可視為「代理式AI元年」，AI運算從模型訓練走向多工自主推理與實際應用，隨著輝達次世代Vera Rubin平台逐步量產，持續留意AI伺服器對運算、傳輸與散熱規格要求提高，同時，晶圓代工、先進封裝、高階載板與矽光子等環節持續升級。
paras_en: During the "AI Computing Power New Landscape Forum Amid US-China Competition" hosted by Quanta Capital Securities, it was noted that as China’s AI large models accelerate, the US‑China tech war is expanding from model capabilities to chips, computing power, high‑speed transmission, energy infrastructure and application ecosystems, creating a new wave of industry investment opportunities. 2026 is seen as the "proxy AI year," with wafer foundries, advanced packaging, high‑end substrates and silicon photonics continuously upgrading, adding growth momentum to Taiwan’s supply chain.

Quanta Investment Advisory explained that the United States continues to consolidate its AI advantage through advanced chips, computing power and platform ecosystems, while China is speeding up the development of an independent supply chain and foundational infrastructure to strengthen its overall computing ecosystem.

On the policy side, China has elevated "Artificial Intelligence+" to a national strategic level, accelerating the construction of new‑type power grids, computing networks and next‑generation communication networks—the "three new networks"—with an investment scale of about 10 trillion yuan, supporting AI infrastructure and independent supply‑chain development.

The massive infrastructure spending also creates new business opportunities for energy, transmission and key components; AI data centers operate 24/7, driving up electricity and storage demand, prompting companies like CATL to accelerate storage and sodium‑battery deployments. Higher computing density fuels growth in specialty optical fibers and 800 G/1.6 T high‑end optical transceiver modules, putting firms such as Zhongji Xuchuang and Changfei Optical Fiber Cable in the spotlight.

On the materials side, Jiantao Interconnect and Shenghong Technology are positioning themselves in copper‑foil substrates, high‑end HDI and multilayer PCBs, reflecting the push for supply‑chain autonomy in China.

Quanta Investment Advisory further noted that beyond hardware competition, as the gap in large‑model capabilities narrows, industry focus is shifting to application ecosystems and enterprise adoption. Enterprise‑grade AI agents that integrate workflows, data and office systems, thanks to their stickiness and commercial potential, are driving AI from "model capability" toward "application monetization."

Therefore, this year can be regarded as the "proxy AI year," with AI computing moving from model training to multitask autonomous inference and real‑world applications. As Nvidia’s next‑generation Vera Rubin platform rolls out gradually, attention should remain on the rising computational, transmission and thermal‑management requirements of AI servers, while wafer foundries, advanced packaging, high‑end substrates and silicon photonics continue to upgrade.

items.title: AI電力軟體族群撐盤 台股高檔震盪 009831瞄準算力掌4大黃金配置
items.title_en: AI Power Software Sector Supports the Market; Taiwan Stocks Trade in High-Range Oscillation; 009831 Targets Four Key AI-Related Gold Allocations
paras: AI題材持續主導台股資金動向，加權指數今 (21) 日震盪走高，除半導體與AI伺服器供應鏈維持人氣外，重電、能源及雲端軟體概念股也同步吸引買盤進駐。法人指出，AI產業正從過去建置算力的上半場，逐步邁向算力變現的新階段，市場關注焦點也從硬體延伸至電力、軟體與應用服務。
近期華城 (1519-TW)、士電 (1503-TW)、中興電 (1513-TW)、亞力 (1514-TW)等重電族群表現強勢，反映AI資料中心帶來龐大電力需求。市場分析，AI競賽不只是GPU與伺服器的競爭，更牽動電網升級、能源配送與備援電力等基礎建設需求，AI的盡頭是電力已成市場共識。
根據國際能源總署（IEA）統計，以AI為主的資料中心，2025年用電量年增幅達50%，2030年前全球資料中心用電需求更有機會接近翻倍。投信法人表示，AI推論與代理型AI（AI Agent）普及後，單次任務耗電量大幅提升，未來AI使用量增加，也將同步推升電力供應鏈需求。
另一方面，AI商業模式也逐漸明朗。包括Google Cloud、Microsoft Copilot與Tesla FSD等服務，已開始將AI使用量轉化為實際營收與獲利，市場認為，AI產業下一階段將進入企業付費、軟體訂閱與應用落地的變現時代。
不過，目前台股AI受惠重心仍偏向晶片與硬體供應鏈，資訊服務與數位雲端相關市值占比相對有限。隨著AI投資邏輯轉向電力與應用並重，市場近期也開始關注橫跨電力、硬體、軟體與應用的全球AI主題ETF。
富蘭克林華美投信即將推出FT核心AI電力算力ETF（009831-TW），預計10月5日至10月8日展開募集，採電力供應鏈40%、硬體20%、軟體20%、應用20%固定配置，聚焦AI發展過程中最具成長潛力的四大領域，涵蓋電網、核能、晶片、雲端軟體及AI應用等產業鏈，希望掌握AI從算力建設到應用變現的完整商機。
法人分析，過去3年市場賺的是蓋算力的錢，下一波AI行情關鍵，將是誰能真正把算力轉化為營收與獲利；在AI需求持續擴張下，電力、軟體與應用服務的重要性正持續升溫。

paras_en: AI themes continue to dominate the flow of capital in Taiwan stocks, with the weighted index edging higher today (the 21st). In addition to semiconductors and AI server supply chains maintaining popularity, heavy‑electric, energy and cloud‑software concept stocks also attracted buying interest. Institutional investors note that the AI industry is moving from the first half focused on building compute capacity to a new stage of monetizing that compute, shifting market focus from hardware to electricity, software and application services.

Recently, heavy‑electric groups such as Huacheng (1519‑TW), Shidian (1503‑TW), Zhongxing Electric (1513‑TW) and A‑Li (1514‑TW) have performed strongly, reflecting the massive power demand generated by AI data centers. Analysts say the AI race is not only about GPUs and servers but also drives upgrades to power grids, energy distribution and backup power infrastructure, and that the consensus is AI’s ultimate demand is electricity.

According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), AI‑driven data centers are projected to see a 50% year‑over‑year increase in electricity consumption by 2025, and global data‑center power demand could almost double by 2030. Mutual‑fund institutions state that as AI inference and AI agents become widespread, the electricity used per task will rise sharply, and growing AI usage will simultaneously boost demand for the power‑supply chain.

On the other hand, AI business models are becoming clearer. Services such as Google Cloud, Microsoft Copilot and Tesla FSD have already begun converting AI usage into actual revenue and profit. The market believes the next phase of the AI industry will enter an era of corporate‑paid, software‑subscription and application‑driven monetization.

However, the current AI benefit in Taiwan stocks still leans toward chips and hardware supply chains, with the market‑cap share of information services and digital cloud relatively limited. As AI investment logic shifts toward a balance of power and applications, the market has recently started to focus on global AI‑themed ETFs that span electricity, hardware, software and applications.

Franklin Templeton Taiwan is set to launch the FT Core AI Power Compute ETF (009831‑TW), with fundraising scheduled from October 5 to October 8. The fund will allocate a fixed 40% to the power‑supply chain, 20% to hardware, 20% to software and 20% to applications, targeting the four most growth‑potential areas in AI development, covering power grids, nuclear energy, chips, cloud software and AI applications, aiming to capture the full business opportunity from compute building to application monetization.

Institutional analysts say that over the past three years the market earned money by building compute capacity; the next AI wave will hinge on who can truly turn that compute into revenue and profit. With AI demand continuously expanding, the importance of power, software and application services is heating up.

items.title: 首超GPU！小摩：2027年ASIC/XPU佔比54% 今年客製化AI ASIC規模約600-700億美元
items.title_en: Top GPU No More! JPMorgan: ASIC/XPU Share to Reach 54% in 2027, Custom AI ASIC Market About $60‑70 B This Year
paras: 摩根大通(下稱小摩)最新半導體報告預估，AI加速器出貨結構將在2027年出現拐點，ASIC/XPU佔比由今年約41%升至54%，首次超過通用GPU，2028年再升至55%。若按數量估算，2027年ASIC/XPU約1250萬顆、GPU約1090萬顆。
報告同時估計，今年客製化AI ASIC市場規模約600億至700億美元，未來數年的年複合成長率超過40%至50%，成為半導體景氣核心增量。
驅動力來自雲端廠商自研趨勢。谷歌TPU、亞馬遜Trainium、微軟Maia、Meta MTIA等XPU針對大規模推理、推薦、訓練特定負載優化，目標是壓低每token成本、功耗與對通用GPU的單一依賴。
相較於「萬能」GPU，ASIC犧牲通用性換取能效與總擁有成本。小摩指出，這不是GPU被替代，而是AI基礎設施由「通用為主」轉向「GPU訓練＋客製化晶片規模化推理」雙軌。
目前，博通與邁威爾科技合計佔客製化AI ASIC市場約90%，其中博通約80%至85%，受益於谷歌長期TPU、Meta、OpenAI等客戶設計服務，邁威爾則大約10%至12%，涵蓋亞馬遜、微軟、谷歌部分互連與記憶體附加晶片。
小摩在報告中特別說明，谷歌TPU等供應鏈資訊不透明不等同訂單走弱，博通與谷歌5年協議涵蓋2026至2031年，橫跨3奈米、2奈米與先進封裝，並有逐年遞增營收安排，收入可見度較強。後續觀察點在2奈米產能、CoWoS/先進封裝、HBM配貨及雲端廠商自研量產節奏。若ASIC出貨如期過半，博通、邁威爾及周邊IP、先進封裝鏈將持續受惠，但客戶自研比例提升也會在中長期削弱設計服務商議價空間。
paras_en: JPMorgan (referred to as JPM) estimates in its latest semiconductor report that the AI accelerator shipment mix will hit a turning point in 2027, with ASIC/XPU share rising from roughly 41% this year to 54%, overtaking general‑purpose GPUs for the first time, and climbing to 55% in 2028. In unit terms, JPM projects about 12.5 million ASIC/XPU chips and 10.9 million GPUs shipped in 2027.

The report also estimates the custom AI ASIC market size at about $60 billion to $70 billion this year, with a compound annual growth rate of over 40%‑50% in the coming years, making it a core growth driver for the semiconductor cycle.

The driver is the cloud providers’ trend toward in‑house designs. Google’s TPU, Amazon’s Trainium, Microsoft’s Maia and Meta’s MTIA are XPU products optimized for large‑scale inference, recommendation and training workloads, aiming to lower per‑token cost, power consumption and dependence on general‑purpose GPUs.

Compared with the “universal” GPU, ASICs sacrifice flexibility for higher energy efficiency and lower total cost of ownership. JPM notes this is not a replacement of GPUs, but a shift of AI infrastructure from a “general‑purpose‑dominant” model to a dual‑track approach of “GPU training plus mass‑scale inference on custom chips.”

Currently Broadcom and Marvell together account for roughly 90% of the custom AI ASIC market, with Broadcom holding about 80%‑85% thanks to long‑term TPU, Meta, OpenAI and other customer design services, while Marvell captures about 10%‑12%, covering parts of Amazon, Microsoft and Google interconnect and memory‑side chips.

JPM specifically points out that opaque supply‑chain information for Google’s TPU does not imply weakening orders. Broadcom’s five‑year agreement with Google, covering 2026‑2031 and spanning 3 nm, 2 nm and advanced packaging, includes stepped‑up revenue targets, giving strong visibility. Future watch points include 2 nm capacity, CoWoS/advanced packaging, HBM allocation and the production pace of cloud providers’ in‑house designs. If ASIC shipments reach the projected share, Broadcom, Marvell and related IP, advanced‑packaging chains will continue to benefit, though a higher proportion of customer‑developed chips could erode design‑service firms’ bargaining power in the medium to long term.

items.title: 官方統計：受戰爭影響 伊朗經濟萎縮10%
items.title_en: Official Statistics: Iran's Economy Shrinks 10% Due to War
paras: 據《法新社》報導，自2月下旬美國與以色列發動襲擊以來，伊朗經濟萎縮約10%。
伊朗統計中心20日（周日）發布的數據顯示，從3月下旬到6月下旬（伊朗稱之為波斯曆第一季），國內生產總額（GDP）較去年同期下降10.1%。
自2月下旬以來，伊朗一直與美國處於戰爭狀態。當時美國和以色列的空襲導致伊朗最高領袖和多名高階軍官喪生，拉開了大規模攻勢序幕。
這些襲擊引發伊朗封鎖荷姆茲海峽的報復行動，隨後全球石油價格飆漲，衝突也蔓延至中東。
除戰爭因素之外，伊朗經濟受美國長期制裁影響，一直飽受惡性通貨膨脹和貨幣貶值困擾。
卡達外交部發言人馬吉德·安薩里20日表示，卡達正與美國和伊朗保持溝通，推動美伊恢復談判。他說，多名美國政府官員表示，美方希望達成協議，結束衝突。
安薩里在美國紐約舉行的卡達經濟論壇期間表示，過去幾周卡達一直與美國和伊朗交換意見，努力彌合分歧，但他沒有給出談判恢復的時間表。
他說：「我們聽到多名美國政府官員表態，確認美國希望達成協議，希望找到結束這場戰爭的解決方案。」
安薩里表示，任何解決方案都應確保中東穩定，同時推動國際社會就保護包括荷姆茲海峽在內的戰略水道達成共識。他指出，曼德海峽目前也受到中東衝突影響。
paras_en: According to AFP, Iran’s economy has contracted by about 10% since the United States and Israel launched attacks in late February.
Data released by Iran’s Statistical Center on Sunday the 20th shows that from late March to late June (the first quarter of the Persian calendar), gross domestic product fell 10.1% year‑on‑year.

Iran has been in a state of war with the United States since late February, when U.S. and Israeli airstrikes killed the Iranian Supreme Leader’s top aide and several senior military officers, kicking off a large‑scale offensive.
The strikes prompted Iran to retaliate by closing the Strait of Hormuz, after which global oil prices surged and the conflict spread across the Middle East.
Beyond the war, Iran’s economy has long been hampered by U.S. sanctions, suffering from runaway inflation and a depreciating currency.

Qatar’s foreign ministry spokesperson Majid Al‑Ansari said on the 20th that Qatar is maintaining communications with the United States and Iran to push for the resumption of U.S.–Iran talks, noting that several U.S. officials have expressed a desire to reach an agreement and end the fighting.

Speaking at the Qatar Economic Forum in New York, Al‑Ansari said Qatar has been exchanging views with the United States and Iran over the past weeks to bridge differences, but he gave no timeline for the restart of negotiations.
He added, “We have heard multiple U.S. officials state that the United States wants to reach a deal and find a solution to end this war.”

Al‑Ansari said any solution must ensure stability in the Middle East while encouraging the international community to reach consensus on protecting strategic waterways, including the Strait of Hormuz, and noted that the Strait of Mand is also being affected by the regional conflict.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉富驊業務多點開花2027年營運看旺 跳空漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Fu Hua's Business Blossoms Across Multiple Segments, 2027 Outlook Strong, Gaps Up to Limit Up
paras: 富驊(5465-TW)旗下高密度硬碟儲存系統、HPC伺服器、AI高速網路設備及水冷分歧管等業務逐步發酵，再加上泰國廠明年投產挹注，看好明年營收獲利跳增，激勵富驊今(21)日股價表現亮眼，跳空漲停。
富驊早盤即跳空漲停，鎖住29.35元，飛越年線，排隊委買單超過1000張，成交量則約600張。三大法人雖上周無太多著墨，不過仍連續5個交易日買超，合計買超67張。
富驊指出，高密度硬碟儲存系統訂單能見度看至2029年；HPC伺服器斬獲北美一線電腦品牌廠訂單，明年第一季將量產；網通產品上，最新世代1.6T傳輸速度交換器產品，明年第一季開始出貨給北美一線AI廠商；光通訊的光模組產品，預計明年量產；水冷散熱關鍵零組件部分，目前分歧管(Manifold)專案已進入客戶送驗及驗證階段。
除產品展望正面，富驊於泰國建置完整機櫃生產能力，預計明年投產，目前也已取得HPC客戶海外生產及確認，屆時可望帶來營收貢獻。
paras_en: Fu Hua (5465‑TW) sees its high‑density hard‑disk storage systems, HPC servers, AI high‑speed networking equipment, and water‑cooling manifolds gradually gaining traction. With a new plant in Thailand slated to start production next year, the company expects a sharp jump in revenue and profit, prompting its stock to surge dramatically and hit the limit‑up price today (the 21st).

The stock opened with a gap‑up limit‑up, locking in at NT$29.35, soaring above its yearly moving average. Over 1,000 buy orders queued on the bid side, while trading volume was about 600 shares. Although the three major institutional investors did not comment much last week, they have been net buyers for five consecutive trading days, buying a total of 67 lots.

Fu Hua noted that orders for its high‑density hard‑disk storage systems are visible through 2029. The HPC server line has secured an order from a top North American computer brand, with mass production slated for the first quarter of next year. In networking, the latest‑generation 1.6‑Tbps switch will begin shipping to a leading North American AI company in Q1 2025. Its optical communication modules are expected to enter mass production next year, and the water‑cooling manifold project is now in the customer testing and verification stage.

Beyond product outlooks, Fu Hua is building a full‑scale rack‑mount production line in Thailand, expected to commence operations next year. The company has also secured overseas production confirmation from an HPC customer, which should contribute to revenue once the plant is up and running.

items.title: 政院推動桃竹苗大矽谷計畫 國產苗栗廠擁利基挹注業績動能
items.title_en: Government Pushes Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan; Domestic Miaoli Plant Gains Niche to Boost Revenue Momentum
paras: 全球AI浪潮來襲，持續推升半導體產業鏈建廠需求，也帶動桃竹苗西部科技廊帶快速成形。混凝土大廠國產(2504-TW)苗栗廠擁有科技行控與大量澆築高供應力，隨著「桃竹苗大矽谷計畫」陸續推動，未來可望搶攻AI科技建廠與房建商機，業績持續穩健成長。
行政院積極推動「桃竹苗大矽谷計畫」，苗栗作為西部科技廊帶的重要節點，規劃竹南科學園區及其東側、頭份交流道周邊，以及後龍科學產業園區為重點開發區；近期也預計在苗栗市解編15.15公頃公保地，釋出8.8公頃住宅與商業區，承接竹科外溢人口與生活機能，帶動大矽谷高科技生活圈的房市供給。
國產苗栗廠位於銅鑼鄉，擁有科技行控與大量澆築高供應力，過去供應銅鑼科學園區八成科技建廠，包括富田電機、太平洋醫材、盟立自動化、億光電子、達邁科技、日商福吉米、台灣納美仕、力積電等科技大廠。
其中，力積電銅鑼新廠混凝土需求達30萬立方米，由苗栗廠主力供應，主體結構採用6,000磅高強度混凝土，並因地基厚實採用國產建材巨積混凝土，協助大型廠房快速建廠。如今該廠已由全球記憶體大廠美光收購，作為擴充DRAM產能的重要基地。
近期，國產苗栗廠也供應聯發科資料數據中心興建，該資料數據中心因應邊緣AI與雲端AI解決方案研發需求，以綠建築最高等級鑽石級規格打造，預計分三期建置。第一期主體結構採用國產建材6,000磅高強度混凝土，總需求約2.5萬立方米，已於今年5月落成啟用。此外，聯詠未來也規劃在銅科興建運算中心，美光則計畫擴建二期廠區，混凝土需求上看12萬立方米，均為國產苗栗廠積極爭取的目標。
科技建廠效應持續擴散，也帶動苗栗房建市場升溫，目前以後龍高鐵特區、苗栗市、銅鑼及公館等地最受矚目。後龍高鐵特區方面，國產苗栗廠供應包括「苗栗全樂齡居宅」、「傳家寶」系列、「高鐵名邸」1至3期、「新站締寶2」及「寶得新幹線」等指標建案。其中，名軒開發在後龍市區推出基地2570坪造鎮型新案，規劃三棟地下3層、地上15層建築，總戶數453戶，混凝土需求4.5萬立方米，也由國產苗栗廠供應。
苗栗市方面，國產苗栗廠則供應「栗都心悅」、「志聯玥華」、「昊翰」、「瀧淳NO.3」、「輕井澤12-星居」、「昇雲探花」等指標建案。隨著聯發科、美光等科技大廠進駐，銅鑼周邊房市也熱絡，包括興建中的「溢家City One」、「銅科芳華」等建案，同樣由國產苗栗廠供應。
隨著「桃竹苗大矽谷計畫」推動，後龍科學產業園區將成為苗栗廠未來重要布局區域；竹南、頭份則主要由國產新竹廠供應，但苗栗廠也可協力支援，展現區域聯防優勢。
paras_en: The global AI wave is driving up demand for semiconductor‑industry construction, rapidly shaping a western Taiwan tech corridor across Taoyuan, Hsinchu and Miaoli. Domestic Concrete (2504‑TW) Miaoli plant, with its advanced process control and high‑capacity pouring capability, is poised to capture AI‑related factory and building projects as the “Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan” rolls out, keeping its earnings on a steady growth path.

The Executive Yuan is actively advancing the “Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan.” Miaoli, a key node of the western tech corridor, will focus on developing the Zhunan Science Park and its eastern side, the Toufen interchange area, and the Houlong Science Industrial Park. In the near term, about 15.15 ha of public‑owned land in Miaoli City will be re‑zoned, releasing 8.8 ha for residential and commercial use to accommodate spill‑over population and amenities from Hsinchu Science Park, fueling housing supply for the high‑tech lifestyle zone.

Domestic’s Miaoli plant is located in Tongluo Township and boasts advanced process control and high‑volume concrete pouring capacity. Historically it has supplied roughly 80 % of the concrete for technology factories in the Tongluo Science Park, serving major firms such as Futian Electric, Pacific Medical Devices, Mingtai Automation, Everlight Electronics, Dami Technology, Japan’s Fujimi, Taiwan Nami, and Powerchip Semiconductor.

Powerchip Semiconductor’s new Tongluo plant requires 300,000 m³ of concrete, primarily sourced from the Miaoli plant. The main structure uses 6,000‑psi high‑strength concrete and, because of the solid foundation, employs Domestic’s “Juchih” concrete, enabling rapid construction of the large facility. The plant has since been acquired by global memory leader Micron as a key DRAM capacity expansion site.

Recently, Domestic’s Miaoli plant also supplied concrete for MediaTek’s data‑center construction. The center, built to support edge‑AI and cloud‑AI R&D, is being erected to the highest “Diamond” green‑building standard in three phases. Phase 1, using Domestic’s 6,000‑psi concrete, calls for about 25,000 m³ and was completed and commissioned in May this year. In addition, Novatek plans a computing center in Tongluo, and Micron is eyeing a Phase 2 expansion requiring roughly 120,000 m³ of concrete—both projects are actively pursued by the Miaoli plant.

The tech‑construction boom is heating Miaoli’s housing market, with the Houlong High‑Speed Rail zone, Miaoli City, Tongluo and Gongguan drawing the most attention. In the Houlong HSR zone, Domestic supplies projects such as “Miaoli All‑Ages Residence,” the “Family Treasure” series, “High‑Speed Rail Residences” Phases 1‑3, “New Station Treasure 2,” and “Bao‑De High‑Speed Line.” Notably, Ming‑Xuan Development’s 2,570‑ping town‑type project in downtown Houlong, featuring three underground and 15 above‑ground floors with 453 units, requires 45,000 m³ of concrete from Domestic’s Miaoli plant.

In Miaoli City, Domestic provides concrete for flagship projects like “Li‑Du Heart‑Joy,” “Zhi‑Lian Yue‑Hua,” “Hao‑Han,” “Long‑Jun NO.3,” “Karuizawa 12‑Star Residence,” and “Sheng‑Yun Tan‑Hua.” With MediaTek, Micron and other tech giants moving in, the surrounding Tongluo housing market is also bustling, including under‑construction projects such as “Yi‑Jia City One” and “Tongluo Fang‑Hua,” also supplied by the Miaoli plant.

As the “Taoyuan‑Zhu‑Miao Grand Silicon Valley Plan” advances, the Houlong Science Industrial Park will become a key future focus for the Miaoli plant. While Zhunan and Toufen will mainly be served by Domestic’s Hsinchu plant, the Miaoli facility can also provide support, showcasing the regional collaborative advantage.

items.title_en: Active ETF Newcomer Weekly Gain Rankings Released: 00411A Soars Over 4% to Claim the Top Spot
paras: 台股在國際利率不確定性趨緩及AI題材帶動下震盪走高，主動式ETF也受到激勵普遍皆有好的表現。其中，今年以來掛牌的19檔主動式ETF「新人」中，以主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)近一周股價漲幅表現最佳，在19檔新人中以唯一超過4%的漲幅表現，拿下周漲幅冠軍，同時也是上櫃外資買超首選。
觀察主動式ETF今年掛牌新人近一周股價漲幅表現，前五名依序為：主動統一前沿科技(00411A-TW)4.22%、主動富邦台灣龍耀(00405A-TW)3.26%、主動安聯台灣(00993A-TW)2.59%、主動兆豐台灣豐收(00996A-TW)2.48%、主動永豐科技趨勢(00410A-TW)1.94%。
00411A上周亦獲得外資資金挹注，買超數達5.4萬張，位居上櫃買超第一名！反映市場資金對其投資主軸與後市表現的關注度升溫。另外，00411A更在上周五收在10.13元創下股價新高後，今(21)開盤持續上攻挑戰新高，盤中最高價達10.22元。
展望後市，主動統一前沿科技ETF經理人郭智偉表示，近期通膨變化除受到油價波動影響，也反映經濟維持良性循環下的需求支撐，以及AI投資擴大所帶來的成長動能。整體而言，美國經濟仍維持正向成長，企業獲利維持雙位數成長；隨AI伺服器新品預計自第四季起逐步放量出貨，市場對企業獲利的預估仍有上修機會。
郭智偉進一步表示，短線上總體環境與市場情緒仍可能受到消息面干擾，但企業基本面尚穩健，長期股市表現仍將以獲利成長為主要依歸。AI仍是驅動科技產業與資本市場的重要趨勢，後續將持續關注AI基礎建設、AI軟體、資產代幣化、自動駕駛、太空經濟與量子運算等主題的技術進展及投資機會。

paras_en: Taiwan stocks rose amid easing international interest‑rate uncertainty and AI‑related themes, and active ETFs were broadly buoyed, delivering solid performance. Among the 19 active‑ETF newcomers listed this year, the Active Uni‑Frontier Technology ETF (00411A‑TW) posted the best weekly price gain, the only one to exceed a 4% rise, earning the weekly gain champion title and becoming the top pick for foreign investors on the OTC market.

Overall, the U.S. economy remains on a positive growth path, with corporate earnings still posting double‑digit growth; with new AI server models expected to ramp up shipments from Q4 onward, market earnings forecasts may still be revised upward.

Guo added that short‑term market sentiment could still be swayed by news flow, but corporate fundamentals remain solid, and long‑term market performance will continue to be driven by earnings growth. AI remains a key catalyst for the technology sector and capital markets, and the team will keep monitoring developments and investment opportunities in AI infrastructure, AI software, asset tokenization, autonomous driving, space economy, and quantum computing.

items.title: 群益：美中科技戰升級 這些族群添台供應鏈成長動能
items.title_en: Quanta: US-China Tech War Escalates, These Sectors Boost Taiwan Supply Chain Growth Momentum
paras: 群益金鼎證券舉辦「美中競逐下的AI算力新局論壇」時指出，隨著中國AI大模型加速追趕，美中科技戰從模型能力延伸至晶片、算力、高速傳輸、能源建設與應用生態，帶動新一波產業投資機會，看2026年是「代理式AI元年」，晶圓代工、先進封裝、高階載板和矽光子等環節持續升級，為台灣供應鏈增添成長動能。
群益投顧說明，美國持續以先進晶片、算力和平台生態鞏固AI優勢，中國則加快自主供應鏈與基礎建設布局，補強整體算力生態系。
政策面上，中國將「人工智慧+」提升至國家戰略層級，加速建設新型電網、算力網和新一代通信網「三新網」，相關投資規模上看人民幣10兆元，為AI基礎建設與自主供應鏈發展提供支撐。
而龐大基建投資也為能源、傳輸與關鍵零組件帶來新商機；由於AI資料中心全天候運轉，推升電力與儲能需求，寧德時代等業者加快儲能與鈉電池布局；算力密度提升則帶動特種光纖及800G、1.6T高階光收發模組成長，中際旭創、長飛光纖光纜等業者備受關注。
在材料端，建滔積層板、勝宏科技分別布局銅箔基板、高階HDI與多層PCB，反映中國供應鏈自主化進程。
群益投顧進一步指出，硬體競逐之外，隨著大型模型能力差距縮小，產業焦點正轉向應用生態與企業導入。能整合工作流程、資料與辦公系統的企業級AI Agent，因具使用黏著度與商業化潛力，正推動AI從「模型能力」走向「應用變現」。
因此，今年可視為「代理式AI元年」，AI運算從模型訓練走向多工自主推理與實際應用，隨著輝達次世代Vera Rubin平台逐步量產，持續留意AI伺服器對運算、傳輸與散熱規格要求提高，同時，晶圓代工、先進封裝、高階載板與矽光子等環節持續升級。
paras_en: During the "AI Computing Power New Landscape Forum Amid US-China Competition" hosted by Quanta Capital Securities, it was noted that as China’s AI large models accelerate, the US‑China tech war is expanding from model capabilities to chips, computing power, high‑speed transmission, energy infrastructure and application ecosystems, creating a new wave of industry investment opportunities. 2026 is seen as the "proxy AI year," with wafer foundries, advanced packaging, high‑end substrates and silicon photonics continuously upgrading, adding growth momentum to Taiwan’s supply chain.

Quanta Investment Advisory explained that the United States continues to consolidate its AI advantage through advanced chips, computing power and platform ecosystems, while China is speeding up the development of an independent supply chain and foundational infrastructure to strengthen its overall computing ecosystem.

On the policy side, China has elevated "Artificial Intelligence+" to a national strategic level, accelerating the construction of new‑type power grids, computing networks and next‑generation communication networks—the "three new networks"—with an investment scale of about 10 trillion yuan, supporting AI infrastructure and independent supply‑chain development.

The massive infrastructure spending also creates new business opportunities for energy, transmission and key components; AI data centers operate 24/7, driving up electricity and storage demand, prompting companies like CATL to accelerate storage and sodium‑battery deployments. Higher computing density fuels growth in specialty optical fibers and 800 G/1.6 T high‑end optical transceiver modules, putting firms such as Zhongji Xuchuang and Changfei Optical Fiber Cable in the spotlight.

On the materials side, Jiantao Interconnect and Shenghong Technology are positioning themselves in copper‑foil substrates, high‑end HDI and multilayer PCBs, reflecting the push for supply‑chain autonomy in China.

Quanta Investment Advisory further noted that beyond hardware competition, as the gap in large‑model capabilities narrows, industry focus is shifting to application ecosystems and enterprise adoption. Enterprise‑grade AI agents that integrate workflows, data and office systems, thanks to their stickiness and commercial potential, are driving AI from "model capability" toward "application monetization."

Therefore, this year can be regarded as the "proxy AI year," with AI computing moving from model training to multitask autonomous inference and real‑world applications. As Nvidia’s next‑generation Vera Rubin platform rolls out gradually, attention should remain on the rising computational, transmission and thermal‑management requirements of AI servers, while wafer foundries, advanced packaging, high‑end substrates and silicon photonics continue to upgrade.

items.title: AI電力軟體族群撐盤 台股高檔震盪 009831瞄準算力掌4大黃金配置
items.title_en: AI Power Software Sector Supports the Market; Taiwan Stocks Trade in High-Range Oscillation; 009831 Targets Four Key AI-Related Gold Allocations
paras: AI題材持續主導台股資金動向，加權指數今 (21) 日震盪走高，除半導體與AI伺服器供應鏈維持人氣外，重電、能源及雲端軟體概念股也同步吸引買盤進駐。法人指出，AI產業正從過去建置算力的上半場，逐步邁向算力變現的新階段，市場關注焦點也從硬體延伸至電力、軟體與應用服務。
近期華城 (1519-TW)、士電 (1503-TW)、中興電 (1513-TW)、亞力 (1514-TW)等重電族群表現強勢，反映AI資料中心帶來龐大電力需求。市場分析，AI競賽不只是GPU與伺服器的競爭，更牽動電網升級、能源配送與備援電力等基礎建設需求，AI的盡頭是電力已成市場共識。
根據國際能源總署（IEA）統計，以AI為主的資料中心，2025年用電量年增幅達50%，2030年前全球資料中心用電需求更有機會接近翻倍。投信法人表示，AI推論與代理型AI（AI Agent）普及後，單次任務耗電量大幅提升，未來AI使用量增加，也將同步推升電力供應鏈需求。
另一方面，AI商業模式也逐漸明朗。包括Google Cloud、Microsoft Copilot與Tesla FSD等服務，已開始將AI使用量轉化為實際營收與獲利，市場認為，AI產業下一階段將進入企業付費、軟體訂閱與應用落地的變現時代。
不過，目前台股AI受惠重心仍偏向晶片與硬體供應鏈，資訊服務與數位雲端相關市值占比相對有限。隨著AI投資邏輯轉向電力與應用並重，市場近期也開始關注橫跨電力、硬體、軟體與應用的全球AI主題ETF。
富蘭克林華美投信即將推出FT核心AI電力算力ETF（009831-TW），預計10月5日至10月8日展開募集，採電力供應鏈40%、硬體20%、軟體20%、應用20%固定配置，聚焦AI發展過程中最具成長潛力的四大領域，涵蓋電網、核能、晶片、雲端軟體及AI應用等產業鏈，希望掌握AI從算力建設到應用變現的完整商機。
法人分析，過去3年市場賺的是蓋算力的錢，下一波AI行情關鍵，將是誰能真正把算力轉化為營收與獲利；在AI需求持續擴張下，電力、軟體與應用服務的重要性正持續升溫。

paras_en: AI themes continue to dominate the flow of capital in Taiwan stocks, with the weighted index edging higher today (the 21st). In addition to semiconductors and AI server supply chains maintaining popularity, heavy‑electric, energy and cloud‑software concept stocks also attracted buying interest. Institutional investors note that the AI industry is moving from the first half focused on building compute capacity to a new stage of monetizing that compute, shifting market focus from hardware to electricity, software and application services.

Recently, heavy‑electric groups such as Huacheng (1519‑TW), Shidian (1503‑TW), Zhongxing Electric (1513‑TW) and A‑Li (1514‑TW) have performed strongly, reflecting the massive power demand generated by AI data centers. Analysts say the AI race is not only about GPUs and servers but also drives upgrades to power grids, energy distribution and backup power infrastructure, and that the consensus is AI’s ultimate demand is electricity.

According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), AI‑driven data centers are projected to see a 50% year‑over‑year increase in electricity consumption by 2025, and global data‑center power demand could almost double by 2030. Mutual‑fund institutions state that as AI inference and AI agents become widespread, the electricity used per task will rise sharply, and growing AI usage will simultaneously boost demand for the power‑supply chain.

On the other hand, AI business models are becoming clearer. Services such as Google Cloud, Microsoft Copilot and Tesla FSD have already begun converting AI usage into actual revenue and profit. The market believes the next phase of the AI industry will enter an era of corporate‑paid, software‑subscription and application‑driven monetization.

However, the current AI benefit in Taiwan stocks still leans toward chips and hardware supply chains, with the market‑cap share of information services and digital cloud relatively limited. As AI investment logic shifts toward a balance of power and applications, the market has recently started to focus on global AI‑themed ETFs that span electricity, hardware, software and applications.

Franklin Templeton Taiwan is set to launch the FT Core AI Power Compute ETF (009831‑TW), with fundraising scheduled from October 5 to October 8. The fund will allocate a fixed 40% to the power‑supply chain, 20% to hardware, 20% to software and 20% to applications, targeting the four most growth‑potential areas in AI development, covering power grids, nuclear energy, chips, cloud software and AI applications, aiming to capture the full business opportunity from compute building to application monetization.

Institutional analysts say that over the past three years the market earned money by building compute capacity; the next AI wave will hinge on who can truly turn that compute into revenue and profit. With AI demand continuously expanding, the importance of power, software and application services is heating up.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉GIS-KY布局矽光子、AR高毛利領域 盤中放量漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: GIS‑KY Positions in Silicon Photonics and High‑Margin AR, Surges to Limit Up on Volume
paras: 觸控面板廠GIS-KY(6456-TW)跨足高階光通訊與AR等高毛利新業務，並於近期追加近34億元資本支出，今(21)日股價強勁，早盤以66.7元開出後，在買盤湧入下迅速攻上漲停價71.9元，成交量逾1.1萬張，較前一日放大近10倍。
GIS-KY董事會日前通過代台灣子公司英特盛科技與越南子公司新增資本支出預算，合計投入33.97億元建置新產品產能。GIS-KY先前預估今年集團總資本支出將落在50億元至60億元之間，市場推估本次大舉擴產將以后里廠為核心，升級為高階光通訊封裝與精密光學製程中心，全力推進矽光子雷射封裝與擴增實境眼鏡光波導技術，預計自明年起逐步貢獻業績。
展望未來營運，法人指出，今年本業仍面臨記憶體缺料與夏普預計於第4季關閉大尺寸面板產線等挑戰，預估全年度營收仍將年減約7.9%。不過車載產品近年客戶與專案持續增加，營收占比有望推升至5%以上，成為本業中穩健成長的支撐動能。
GIS-KY已將長期發展重心轉向高附加價值新事業。包括合發Micro LED及表面浮雕光柵（Surface Relief Grating；SRG）光波導模組，投入連續波雷射封裝與測試設備建置，以及光通訊及AR領域，在未來逐步扭轉營運虧損並重拾成長動能。
paras_en: Touch‑panel maker GIS‑KY (6456‑TW) has expanded into high‑margin businesses such as advanced optical communications and AR, and recently added nearly NT$34 billion of capital expenditure. On the 21st, its stock opened at NT$66.7, quickly rose to the limit‑up price of NT$71.9 amid heavy buying, with volume exceeding 11,000 lots – almost ten times the previous day’s volume.

The board of GIS‑KY recently approved additional capital budgets for its Taiwanese subsidiary IntesTech and its Vietnam subsidiary, totaling NT$33.97 billion to build capacity for new products. The company had previously estimated total group capex for the year at NT$50‑60 billion. The expansion is expected to center on the Huli plant, upgrading it into a high‑end optical‑communication packaging and precision optics processing hub, pushing silicon‑photonic laser packaging and AR‑glass waveguide technology, with contributions to earnings expected to begin gradually from next year.

Looking ahead, analysts note that the core business still faces challenges this year, including memory shortages and Sharp’s plan to shut its large‑panel line in Q4, forecasting a full‑year revenue decline of about 7.9%. However, automotive‑related products have seen a steady increase in customers and projects, and their share of revenue could rise above 5%, providing a stable growth engine within the core business.

GIS‑KY has shifted its long‑term focus to high‑value‑added new ventures, including co‑development of Micro‑LED and surface‑relief‑grating (SRG) waveguide modules, investment in continuous‑wave laser packaging and testing equipment, and expansion in optical‑communication and AR fields, aiming to gradually reverse operating losses and regain growth momentum.

items.title: 【優分析即時新聞】鈺齊-KY(9802)7月營收創43個月新高，On Running挹注訂單惟毛利率承壓
items.title_en: Yuqi-KY (9802) July Revenue Hits 43-Month High, On Running Boosts Orders but Margins Under Pressure
paras: 2026年09月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 鈺齊-KY 2026年營收逐季走揚，7月單月營收21.44億元，月增5.93%、年增30.87%，創43個月新高，8月雖月減20.99%但年增35.31%、為歷年同期次高，前8月累計年增率擴大至8.32%。
訂單能見度約3至4個月，已看到12月至2027年1月，2027年春夏款接單預期仍年增。法人已上修2026全年營收預估至年增16.99%至17.7%，2027年預估年增7.42%，主因接單動能轉強與新廠產能開出。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
獲利與營收明顯脫鉤，關稅與新廠學習曲線三重夾擊真正值得注意的是，上半年毛利率18.73%，年減4.01個百分點，營業利益年減47.98%，明顯與營收成長脫鉤。
公司說明若排除關稅與新廠初期費用，本業毛利率仍有接近18%水準，顯示壓力主要來自外部與擴產初期的一次性因素，並非本業競爭力惡化。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
On Running獨強，客戶集中度持續攀升第一大客戶On Running動能強勁，2025年營收成長逾5成、占比超過2成，2026年法人估占比可望突破25%，客戶集中度持續拉高。
產能擴張超前，資本支出2027年將轉向人均產值產線由59條擴至71條，較年初原估68條上修，擴產速度超前。印尼齊樺廠與越南鈺騰廠已於2025年下半年試產，第二季新廠產能占比由首季1.4%倍增至3%，印尼二期預計2027年初啟動建廠。
人力同步快速擴編，第二季底已達3.38萬人，第三季再增約2,000人。資本支出2025年創高達24.46億元，2026年預估減半至約12億元，2027年將轉向追求人均產值成長。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
風險提醒：原物料波動與新廠學習曲線仍是短期壓力第三季原物料波動仍劇烈、成本無法完全轉嫁，加上新廠學習曲線尚未走完，短期獲利仍承壓，惟公司預期下半年毛利率可望回溫。
評價面股價淨值比低於1，經營層與高階主管2025、2026年已買進數千張持股。

paras_en: September 21, 2026 (Yuqi Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Yuqi-KY’s 2026 revenue has been rising quarter by quarter, with July single‑month revenue reaching NT$2.144 billion, up 5.93% month‑over‑month and 30.87% year‑over‑year, a 43‑month peak. August fell 20.99% month‑over‑month but was up 35.31% year‑over‑year, the second‑highest for the same period in history, and the cumulative year‑over‑year growth for the first eight months expanded to 8.32%.

Order visibility is about three to four months; orders have already been seen from December through January 2027, and the spring‑summer 2027 collection is expected to grow year‑over‑year. Analysts have raised the 2026 full‑year revenue forecast to a 16.99%‑17.7% increase and project a 7.42% rise for 2027, driven by stronger order momentum and the ramp‑up of new‑plant capacity.
(Image source: Yuqi Analysis Industry Database)

Profit and revenue have clearly decoupled. Tariffs and the learning curve of the new plant create a triple hit. Notably, the first‑half gross margin fell to 18.73%, down 4.01 percentage points year‑over‑year, and operating profit dropped 47.98% year‑over‑year, showing a clear disconnect from revenue growth.

The company explains that excluding tariffs and early‑stage new‑plant costs, the core gross margin remains close to 18%, indicating that pressure stems mainly from external factors and one‑time expansion costs rather than a deterioration in core competitiveness.
(Image source: Yuqi Analysis Industry Database)

On Running remains a dominant customer, and client concentration continues to rise. The top customer On Running showed strong momentum, with revenue growth of over 50% in 2025 and accounting for more than 20% of sales; analysts expect its share to exceed 25% in 2026, further lifting client concentration.

Capacity expansion is ahead of schedule. Capital expenditures will shift in 2027 toward per‑employee productivity, with production lines increasing from 59 to 71, an upward revision from the earlier estimate of 68 lines at year‑start. The Indonesia Qihua plant and Vietnam Yuteng plant began trial production in the second half of 2025; the new‑plant share of capacity rose from 1.4% in Q1 to 3% in Q2, and Phase II of the Indonesia plant is slated to start construction in early 2027.

Workforce expansion is keeping pace, reaching 33,800 employees by the end of Q2, with an additional ~2,000 hires planned for Q3. Capital spending peaked at NT$2.446 billion in 2025, is projected to halve to about NT$1.2 billion in 2026, and will shift in 2027 toward driving per‑employee value growth.
(Image source: Yuqi Analysis Industry Database)

Risk reminder: Raw‑material price volatility and the new‑plant learning curve remain short‑term pressures. Raw‑material costs remain volatile in Q3 and cannot be fully passed on, and the new‑plant learning curve is not yet complete, keeping short‑term profitability under pressure. The company expects gross margins to improve in the second half of the year.
Valuation: The price‑to‑book ratio is below 1, and management and senior executives purchased several thousand shares in 2025 and 2026.
