items.title: 首超GPU！小摩：2027年ASIC/XPU佔比54% 今年客製化AI ASIC規模約600-700億美元
items.title_en: Top GPU No More! JPMorgan: ASIC/XPU Share to Reach 54% in 2027, Custom AI ASIC Market About $60‑70 B This Year
paras: 摩根大通(下稱小摩)最新半導體報告預估，AI加速器出貨結構將在2027年出現拐點，ASIC/XPU佔比由今年約41%升至54%，首次超過通用GPU，2028年再升至55%。若按數量估算，2027年ASIC/XPU約1250萬顆、GPU約1090萬顆。
報告同時估計，今年客製化AI ASIC市場規模約600億至700億美元，未來數年的年複合成長率超過40%至50%，成為半導體景氣核心增量。
驅動力來自雲端廠商自研趨勢。谷歌TPU、亞馬遜Trainium、微軟Maia、Meta MTIA等XPU針對大規模推理、推薦、訓練特定負載優化，目標是壓低每token成本、功耗與對通用GPU的單一依賴。
相較於「萬能」GPU，ASIC犧牲通用性換取能效與總擁有成本。小摩指出，這不是GPU被替代，而是AI基礎設施由「通用為主」轉向「GPU訓練＋客製化晶片規模化推理」雙軌。
目前，博通與邁威爾科技合計佔客製化AI ASIC市場約90%，其中博通約80%至85%，受益於谷歌長期TPU、Meta、OpenAI等客戶設計服務，邁威爾則大約10%至12%，涵蓋亞馬遜、微軟、谷歌部分互連與記憶體附加晶片。
小摩在報告中特別說明，谷歌TPU等供應鏈資訊不透明不等同訂單走弱，博通與谷歌5年協議涵蓋2026至2031年，橫跨3奈米、2奈米與先進封裝，並有逐年遞增營收安排，收入可見度較強。後續觀察點在2奈米產能、CoWoS/先進封裝、HBM配貨及雲端廠商自研量產節奏。若ASIC出貨如期過半，博通、邁威爾及周邊IP、先進封裝鏈將持續受惠，但客戶自研比例提升也會在中長期削弱設計服務商議價空間。
paras_en: JPMorgan (referred to as JPM) estimates in its latest semiconductor report that the AI accelerator shipment mix will hit a turning point in 2027, with ASIC/XPU share rising from roughly 41% this year to 54%, overtaking general‑purpose GPUs for the first time, and climbing to 55% in 2028. In unit terms, JPM projects about 12.5 million ASIC/XPU chips and 10.9 million GPUs shipped in 2027.

The report also estimates the custom AI ASIC market size at about $60 billion to $70 billion this year, with a compound annual growth rate of over 40%‑50% in the coming years, making it a core growth driver for the semiconductor cycle.

The driver is the cloud providers’ trend toward in‑house designs. Google’s TPU, Amazon’s Trainium, Microsoft’s Maia and Meta’s MTIA are XPU products optimized for large‑scale inference, recommendation and training workloads, aiming to lower per‑token cost, power consumption and dependence on general‑purpose GPUs.

Compared with the “universal” GPU, ASICs sacrifice flexibility for higher energy efficiency and lower total cost of ownership. JPM notes this is not a replacement of GPUs, but a shift of AI infrastructure from a “general‑purpose‑dominant” model to a dual‑track approach of “GPU training plus mass‑scale inference on custom chips.”

Currently Broadcom and Marvell together account for roughly 90% of the custom AI ASIC market, with Broadcom holding about 80%‑85% thanks to long‑term TPU, Meta, OpenAI and other customer design services, while Marvell captures about 10%‑12%, covering parts of Amazon, Microsoft and Google interconnect and memory‑side chips.

JPM specifically points out that opaque supply‑chain information for Google’s TPU does not imply weakening orders. Broadcom’s five‑year agreement with Google, covering 2026‑2031 and spanning 3 nm, 2 nm and advanced packaging, includes stepped‑up revenue targets, giving strong visibility. Future watch points include 2 nm capacity, CoWoS/advanced packaging, HBM allocation and the production pace of cloud providers’ in‑house designs. If ASIC shipments reach the projected share, Broadcom, Marvell and related IP, advanced‑packaging chains will continue to benefit, though a higher proportion of customer‑developed chips could erode design‑service firms’ bargaining power in the medium to long term.

items.title: 特斯拉機器人團隊在長三角審廠 多家企業接獲訂單
items.title_en: Tesla Robot Team Conducts Factory Audits in the Yangtze River Delta; Multiple Companies Receive Orders
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 機器人團隊落地寧波審廠一事受資本市場關注，產業鏈人士透露，特斯拉機器人團隊上周已於拓普集團(601689-CN) 、三花智控(02050-HK) 、均勝電子(600699-CN) 等供應鏈企業開啟審廠工作。
上述企業主要供給關節模組、執行器、精密結構件等核心機電部件。
「在本次審廠前，這些企業都已經拿到了特斯拉人形機器人的訂單，只是或多或少的區別。審廠將對相關產線品質、合規等方面展開評估，通過後將很快開始生產。」上述人士提到。
據《澎湃新聞》21日（周一）報導，該名產業鏈人士表示，審廠工作並非網傳的只在寧波展開，特斯拉該機器人團隊本次走訪工作還覆蓋杭州、上海等長三角地區供應鏈企業。相關企業基本也都是特斯拉已經有合作的供應鏈企業。
此前有消息稱，特斯拉計劃在今年生產數千台人形機器人。供應鏈審廠工作開啟，意味著特斯拉人形機器人量產工作更進一步。
特斯拉即將開啟量產的是第三代人形機器人，也是其第一款量產機型，相比前代，重點升級手部靈巧機構、關節執行器，優先承擔工廠內物料搬運、簡單流水線輔助等工業任務。單機長期目標成本為2萬～3萬美元。
產能方面，特斯拉原Model S/X生產線已經轉型為特斯拉人形機器人專用生產線，規劃年產能達100萬台。
同時，特斯拉正在德州超級工廠準備機器人第二條產線，長期設計年產能為1,000萬台，預計明年夏季左右投產。馬斯克稱人形機器人量產是特斯拉有史以來量產難度最大的產品。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) robot team’s factory audit in Ningbo has drawn attention from the capital markets. Industry insiders say the team began audits last week at supply‑chain firms including Top Group (601689-CN), SFA Control (02050-HK) and Joyson Electronics (600699-CN).
These companies mainly supply core electromechanical parts such as joint modules, actuators and precision structural components.

"Before these audits, all of these firms had already secured orders for Tesla’s humanoid robot, albeit with varying specifications. The audits will assess production‑line quality, compliance and other factors, and once passed, production will start quickly," the insider said.

According to a report by The Paper on Monday the 21st, the insider clarified that the audits are not limited to Ningbo as online rumors suggest; Tesla’s robot team is also visiting supply‑chain companies in Hangzhou, Shanghai and other parts of the Yangtze River Delta. The firms involved are essentially those already partnered with Tesla.

Earlier reports indicated that Tesla plans to produce several thousand humanoid robots this year. The launch of supply‑chain audits signals that mass production of the robots is moving a step further forward.

Tesla is about to begin mass production of its third‑generation humanoid robot, which will also be its first mass‑produced model. Compared with earlier versions, it features upgraded hand dexterity mechanisms and joint actuators, and will initially handle material handling and simple assembly‑line assistance tasks in factories. The long‑term target cost per unit is $20,000‑$30,000.
In terms of capacity, Tesla’s former Model S/X production line has been converted into a dedicated line for the humanoid robot, with a planned annual output of up to one million units.

At the same time, Tesla is preparing a second robot production line at its Texas Gigafactory, designed for a long‑term annual capacity of 10 million units and expected to start up around summer next year. Elon Musk says mass‑producing the humanoid robot will be the most challenging product Tesla has ever manufactured.

items.title: 「補丁海嘯」來襲！花旗執行長：AI風險上升  企業加速進入防禦競賽
items.title_en: "Patch Tsunami" Hits! Citigroup CEO: AI Risks Rising as Companies Accelerate Into a Defense Race
paras: 花旗集團執行長Jane Fraser最新表示，隨著AI模型能力不斷增強，企業正在加速建立防禦體系，以應對可能增加的網路攻擊風險。
Fraser周日(20日)在紐約舉行的卡達經濟論壇上說：「目前全球所有企業都在進行大量補丁修復，形成了一場防禦競賽。」
她表示，今年稍早Anthropic推出的Mythos模型引發了對新一代AI網路風險的關注，之後美國財長貝森特跟時任Fed主席的鮑爾曾召集華爾街高管討論該模型帶來的風險，並敦促企業加強系統防護。
近期，包括谷歌和Anthropic在內的AI系統在測試中出現入侵企業系統的情況，進一步引發安全疑慮。
對此，與會的卡達首相穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿勒薩尼表示，該國正與AI企業合作進行負責任投資，目前圍繞該技術的安全保障措施仍在改善過程中。
此外，Fraser在論壇上還指出，AI發展的瓶頸已經從晶片轉向能源供應，全球對能源需求正在大幅增加。
paras_en: Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser said that as AI model capabilities continue to improve, companies are speeding up the building of defensive systems to cope with potentially higher cyber‑attack risk.
Speaking at the Qatar Economic Forum in New York on Sunday the 20th, Fraser said, "Currently every company worldwide is undertaking massive patch remediation, creating a defense race."

She noted that earlier this year Anthropic’s launch of the Mythos model sparked concerns about a new generation of AI‑related cyber risks, after which U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and then‑Fed Chair Jerome Powell convened Wall Street executives to discuss the model’s dangers and urged firms to strengthen system protections.
Recent tests have shown AI systems, including those from Google and Anthropic, breaching corporate networks, further raising security worries.

In response, Qatar’s Prime Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al‑Thani said the country is partnering with AI firms on responsible investment, and that safety measures surrounding the technology are still being refined.
Fraser also pointed out at the forum that the bottleneck for AI development has shifted from chips to energy supply, with global energy demand soaring sharply.

items.title: 馬斯克準備在美國德州蓋「超級高鐵」時速321公里
items.title_en: Musk Plans to Build a “Super‑High‑Speed Rail” in Texas at 321 km/h
paras: 美國兩大知名公司——特斯拉(TSLA-US) 和SpaceX(SPCX-US) ——「背後的男人」馬斯克又來整新花樣了。
馬斯克表示，旗下隧道企業「無聊公司」（The Boring Company）計劃在美國德州開發一條連接奧斯汀、聖安東尼奧的城際隧道，可以想像為「簡易版超級高鐵（Hyperloop）」，將兩座城市的交通時間從2.5小時壓縮至30分鐘以下。
根據馬斯克在社交媒體平台X上發表的帖子，擬議的項目將成為馬斯克長期以來討論的超級高鐵概念的先導，移動速度將超過200公里/小時（321.87公里/小時）。
不過，該項目最終能否落實仍是個未知數，「無聊公司」此前宣發的芝加哥、洛杉磯、紐約隧道項目都沒有落實。
「無聊公司」成立於2016年，創辦方式頗具馬斯克一貫風格。當時他因被堵在洛杉磯的交通中而萌生創意，隨後在推特上宣布計劃成立一家隧道網絡公司，目標是終結交通擁堵。
馬斯克表示：「解決交通擁堵是終極Boss戰。即使是世界上最有權勢的人，也無法戰勝交通擁堵。」
該公司最初的目標，是打造具有未來感的「超級高鐵」，利用電動艙體以最高每小時約966公里的速度，讓乘客快速往返城市之間。
paras_en: Elon Musk, the man behind two of America’s most famous companies—Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US)—is up to a new stunt again.

Musk said his tunnel venture, The Boring Company, plans to develop an intercity tunnel in Texas linking Austin and San Antonio, essentially a simplified version of a Hyperloop, which would cut travel time between the two cities from 2.5 hours to under 30 minutes.

According to a post Musk shared on the social media platform X, the proposed project would serve as a pilot for the Hyperloop concept he has long discussed, with a travel speed exceeding 200 km/h (321.87 km/h).
However, whether the project will ever materialize remains uncertain; previous tunnel projects announced by The Boring Company in Chicago, Los Angeles and New York have not come to fruition.

The Boring Company was founded in 2016 in a manner typical of Musk. He conceived the idea after getting stuck in Los Angeles traffic and then announced on Twitter his plan to start a tunnel‑network company aimed at ending congestion.
Musk said, “Solving traffic congestion is the ultimate boss battle. Even the most powerful people in the world can’t defeat traffic jams.”
The company’s original goal was to create a futuristic “Super‑High‑Speed Rail” using electric pods that could travel at up to roughly 966 km per hour, shuttling passengers quickly between cities.

items.title: 股債等多類資產年底或「同步」上漲？高盛：市場升息預期過度悲觀
paras: 高盛策略師認為，市場目前對全球主要央行升息路徑的定價過於悲觀，若通膨壓力隨油價回落而緩解，年底前可能出現股債等多類資產「同步」上漲的交易機會。
高盛研究部高級顧問Dominic Wilson與全球風險主管Josh Schiffrin於近日參加高盛Podcast節目時表示，市場目前預期本輪升息次數約達4次，但實際升息幅度可能僅有2次。
兩人均認為，油價走勢將是決定最終升息路徑的關鍵因素。若能源價格明顯回落，通膨預期可能降溫，進而為債券、股票等多類資產帶來同步走強的條件。
在能源價格大幅反彈、通膨預期升溫的背景下，市場對聯準會（Fed）未來升息幅度的預期持續升高。
Schiffrin表示，油價飆升是今年市場最大的意外之一，除了推升通膨預期，也讓市場對貨幣政策的定價更加激進。
他指出，市場已大幅反映一個完整的緊縮週期，預期升息約4次，但他認為最終升息次數不會達到這個水準；若必須提出具體預測，他傾向於2次。
Wilson也認同這項看法，並表示其基準情境是「10月再升息1次，之後長期暫停」。
Wilson指出，目前市場對聯準會、歐洲央行、日本及加拿大央行的升息幅度，均反映接近4次的預期，但實際升息力度可能低於市場預期。
他認為，若要在升息2次與6次之間做出判斷，升息2次的機率明顯較高。

長天期債券殖利率處高檔　油價回落成反轉關鍵

近期市場持續擔憂財政赤字、通膨黏著性及資本需求競爭等問題，但Schiffrin認為，債券市場已消化大量利空，投資吸引力正在提高。
他指出，10年期美國公債殖利率已升至5%以上，30年期實質殖利率也超過3%，這類票息與實質殖利率水準已是相當長時間未見的高點。
不過，Schiffrin表示，債券市場若要出現反轉，仍需要催化因素，而最可能的觸發點就是油價下跌。
Wilson則從結構面分析實質利率走高的原因。他表示，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮帶動企業融資需求增加，加上政府財政赤字擴大，推升資本競爭壓力；另一方面，經濟成長仍具韌性，也使通膨降溫速度低於預期，進一步支撐較高的政策利率。
他認為，在企業融資需求與經濟成長前景出現實質變化前，長天期公債殖利率大幅下滑的空間有限。
不過，Wilson指出，若AI資本支出週期出現轉折，或經濟遭遇超出預期的下行衝擊，長天期殖利率仍可能明顯回落，但這兩種情境目前都不是高盛的基準預測。

美股展現韌性　年底「全資產上漲」仍待油價配合

Schiffrin表示，美股近期面對油價上漲、殖利率大幅走高及AI監管不確定性等多重壓力，表現卻明顯優於預期。
他認為，這表示市場具有相當韌性，部分反映當前大規模資本支出週期，以及實體經濟仍然強勁。
Wilson則指出，市場目前已反映相當程度的悲觀預期，包括升息4次、實質殖利率上升，以及油價突破每桶100美元等因素。因此，市場未來若出現緩解訊號，反而更容易出現價格修正。
他形容，當前是近期多頭投資者相對清晰的布局窗口，雖然條件不如7月底，但市場氛圍有相似之處。
針對年底前的交易方向，Schiffrin提出3項觀察：

美元可能受到聯準會相對鷹派立場及美國經濟領先優勢支撐而走強。
若美國期中選舉後油價下跌，市場可能出現「全資產上漲」行情，但前提是油價回落。
從中長期來看，超長天期公債目前偏高的實質殖利率仍具配置價值。


Wilson則表示，考慮到市場目前的升息定價，以及通膨可能透過多種途徑降溫，他對年底前利率定價出現修正的信心日益增加，並傾向透過低成本選擇權策略參與潛在行情。

items.title: 借貸成本增+政府融資需求飆！華爾街估短期美債發行規模將破1兆美元
items.title_en: Rising Borrowing Costs and Surging Government Funding Needs Prompt Wall Street to Forecast Short‑Term US Debt Issuance to Top $1 Trillion
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，隨著借貸成本攀升，多家華爾街投行預估，美國未來一年將發行約1兆美元的短期債務，以滿足不斷增長的政府融資需求。
《金融時報》報導，美國銀行預估，在截至2027年9月的新財年中，不計用於償還到期債務的新增借款規模約為1.07兆美元；摩根大通預計2027年短期國債發行規模約1.09兆美元，高盛預計為9610億美元。
短債發行增加之際，美國長期借款成本已升至2007年以來最高水平，財長貝森特此前希望透過擴大10年至30年期美債回購壓低長端利率。
根據美銀預估，到明年9月，美國未償短債規模將攀升至約8兆美元，佔可交易國債比例達24.3%；高盛估該比例明年為24.3%，2028年升至24.9%。這一水準接近欣冠疫情期間高點，而美國財政部借款諮詢委員會先前建議長期維持短債佔比約20%。
分析師表示，增加短債發行有助於降低目前融資成本，但也會提高未來再融資風險。美銀利率策略主管Mark Cabana表示，美國財政部正在平衡債市供需，但大量發行短債恐致利息支出「更大且更波動」。聯準會(Fed)今年來已購買大量短期國債，貨幣市場基金約8兆美元的資產規模也為短債提供需求支持。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that as borrowing costs climb, several Wall Street banks estimate the United States will issue about $1 trillion of short‑term debt over the next year to meet the growing demand for government financing.

The Financial Times cites that US banks project new borrowing, excluding debt repayments, of roughly $1.07 trillion for the fiscal year ending September 2027; JPMorgan forecasts short‑term Treasury issuance of about $1.09 trillion in 2027, while Goldman Sachs expects $961 billion.

As short‑term issuance rises, long‑term borrowing costs in the US have hit their highest level since 2007, and Treasury Secretary Yellen has previously sought to lower long‑end yields by expanding buybacks of 10‑ to 30‑year Treasuries.

According to Bank of America’s outlook, outstanding short‑term debt will climb to about $8 trillion by next September, representing 24.3% of the tradable Treasury market; Goldman Sachs estimates the same share at 24.3% next year, rising to 24.9% in 2028, a level near the pandemic‑era peak, while the Treasury borrowing advisory committee had earlier recommended a long‑run short‑term share around 20%.

Analysts say that increasing short‑term issuance can help lower current financing costs but raises future refinancing risk. Bank of America rate‑strategy head Mark Cabana notes the Treasury is balancing supply and demand in the bond market, but a flood of short‑term issues could make interest expenses “larger and more volatile.” The Fed has bought large amounts of short‑term Treasuries this year, and money‑market funds with about $8 trillion of assets also support demand for short‑term debt.

items.title: 華爾街看好AI「新世代雲端」！「這4股」獲優於大盤評級、AIaaS市場2034年上看4兆美元
items.title_en: Wall Street Bullish on AI "Next‑Gen Cloud"! These 4 Stocks Rated Outperform, AIaaS Market Could Reach $4 Trillion by 2034
paras: 隨著企業對人工智慧（AI）運算資源的需求持續攀升，專門提供AI算力的「新世代雲端」（Neocloud）業者逐漸受到華爾街關注。投資公司Northland Equity Capital Markets的資本市場分析師近日看好多家相關企業，並預期AI即服務（AIaaS）市場規模未來數年將大幅擴張，帶動算力供應商迎來成長機會。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Northland資本市場分析師Nehal Chokshi週五（18日）發布報告，首度針對4家新世代雲端業者展開研究，並給予Iris Energy (IREN-US) 、Boost Run (BRUN-US) 、ChronoScale (CHRN-US) 及SharonAI (SHAZ-US) 「優於大盤」評級。
Chokshi對Iris Energy設定每股99美元的目標價，相較週五收盤價46.68美元，潛在漲幅達112.05%；Boost Run、ChronoScale及SharonAI的目標價則分別為36美元、32美元及95美元。
美股週五交易中，Iris Energy收盤上漲7.36%至46.68美元，Boost Run與SharonAI分別上揚3.54%及1.47%，ChronoScale則上漲1.44%。
Northland看好新世代雲端產業，主要基於對AIaaS市場的成長預期。該服務讓企業與開發者透過網路使用AI能力，不必自行從頭建置複雜的AI系統。
Chokshi估計，AIaaS市場規模到了2034年可能擴大至約4兆美元。
這項預測遠高於基於輝達(NVDA-US) 、博通(AVGO-US) 及超微半導體(AMD-US) 晶片的資料中心需求所推算的數據。該項預測預估AIaaS市場規模到2027年底將達8,530億美元。
AIaaS市場若大幅成長，將為AI算力供應商帶來利多。所謂AI算力，是指硬體晶片用於建置、訓練及運作AI模型所需的基礎運算能力。CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 則是該領域的先行業者之一。
Northland指出，自2025年12月以來，AI算力的每小時租賃價格已上漲約33%。然而，超大規模雲端服務商的收費仍約為新世代雲端業者的3倍，顯示市場價格仍有進一步上調的空間。
亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 網路服務（AWS）及微軟(MSFT-US) 均屬超大規模雲端服務商。
Chokshi表示，只要市場供給持續低於需求，新世代雲端現貨市場的價格上漲動能預料將延續，合約價格也可能隨之走高。
他進一步指出，已建立或正在發展自有軟體生態系的新世代雲端業者，在當前價格環境下尤其具備優勢。
透過整合軟體，新世代雲端業者不必侷限於提供原始算力，還能加入管理及最佳化功能，縮小與超大規模雲端服務商之間的差距，並可能讓客戶更長期地使用其平台。
CoreWeave、Nebius(YNDX-US) 、Iris Energy及ChronoScale均被列為具備相關發展方向的企業。
其中，Iris Energy收購雲端基礎設施與軟體公司Mirantis後，Chokshi認為，該公司已具備發展軟體差異化AIaaS服務的明確路徑。
Northland此次針對Iris Energy的正面評價，並非華爾街近期首度看好該公司。
摩根大通分析師Richard Choe上週一將Iris Energy股票評級從「減碼」連升兩級至「加碼」，並將目標價由46美元上調至65美元。
Choe指出，Iris Energy已轉型為頂級新世代雲端業者。這家原本專注於比特幣挖礦的公司，近年將業務重心轉向AI運算服務，在客戶拓展方面已展現動能；此外，與輝達建立策略合作關係，也為其AI雲端服務業務增添市場認可度。
根據FactSet調查的19家機構資料，Iris Energy目前平均評級為「買進」，平均目標價為82.54美元。
paras_en: As corporate demand for artificial‑intelligence (AI) computing power continues to climb, providers of AI‑focused "next‑gen cloud" services are drawing Wall Street attention. Capital‑markets analysts at Northland Equity Capital Markets have recently taken a positive view on several such firms and expect the AI‑as‑a‑Service (AIaaS) market to expand dramatically over the next few years, creating growth opportunities for compute providers.

According to Barron’s, Northland analyst Nehal Chokshi released a report on Friday the 18th that, for the first time, examines four next‑gen cloud companies and assigns them an "outperform" rating: Iris Energy (IREN‑US), Boost Run (BRUN‑US), ChronoScale (CHRN‑US) and SharonAI (SHAZ‑US).

Chokshi set a target price of $99 per share for Iris Energy, implying a potential upside of 112.05% from Friday’s close of $46.68. The target prices for Boost Run, ChronoScale and SharonAI are $36, $32 and $95 respectively.
In Friday’s U.S. trading, Iris Energy closed up 7.36% at $46.68, while Boost Run and SharonAI rose 3.54% and 1.47% respectively, and ChronoScale gained 1.44%.

Northland is optimistic on the next‑gen cloud sector mainly because of its expectations for AIaaS growth. The service lets enterprises and developers access AI capabilities over the internet without having to build complex AI systems from scratch.
Chokshi estimates the AIaaS market could swell to roughly $4 trillion by 2034.

That forecast far exceeds estimates based on data‑center demand for chips from Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Broadcom (AVGO‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US). The same projection puts the AIaaS market at $853 billion by the end of 2027.

If AIaaS expands rapidly, it will be a tailwind for AI compute suppliers. "AI compute" refers to the hardware needed to build, train and run AI models. CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) is one of the early players in this space.

Northland notes that, since December 2025, hourly rental rates for AI compute have risen about 33%. However, ultra‑large cloud providers still charge roughly three times what next‑gen cloud firms charge, indicating room for further price increases.
Amazon (AMZN‑US) Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) are both ultra‑large cloud providers.
Chokshi says that as long as supply remains below demand, price‑upward momentum in the spot market for next‑gen cloud compute is likely to continue, and contract prices could rise as well.
He adds that next‑gen cloud firms that have built or are developing their own software ecosystems enjoy a particular advantage in the current pricing environment.

By integrating software, next‑gen cloud providers are not limited to raw compute; they can add management and optimization features, narrowing the gap with ultra‑large clouds and potentially encouraging longer‑term platform usage by customers.
CoreWeave, Nebius (YNDX‑US), Iris Energy and ChronoScale are all cited as companies pursuing these development paths.
After Iris Energy’s acquisition of cloud‑infrastructure and software company Mirantis, Chokshi believes the firm now has a clear path to differentiated, software‑driven AIaaS offerings.
Northland’s positive view on Iris Energy is not Wall Street’s first recent endorsement of the company.
JPMorgan analyst Richard Choe upgraded Iris Energy’s rating from "underweight" two notches to "overweight" last Monday and raised the target price from $46 to $65.

Choe notes that Iris Energy has transformed into a top‑tier next‑gen cloud player. Originally a Bitcoin‑mining company, it has shifted its focus to AI compute services, showing momentum in customer acquisition, and its strategic partnership with Nvidia adds market credibility to its AI cloud business.
FactSet’s survey of 19 institutional investors shows Iris Energy currently carries an average rating of "Buy" with an average target price of $82.54.

items.title: 10月股市「崩盤魔咒」是迷思？分析：反而是逢低布局機會
items.title_en: Is the October Stock‑Market “Crash Curse” a Myth? Analysis: It May Actually Be a Buying‑the‑Dip Opportunity
paras: 10月向來被視為美股崩盤高風險月份，但分析人士指出，投資人對「10月魔咒」的擔憂，反而可能壓低市場表現，創造逢低布局機會。歷史數據顯示，標普500指數自1957年以來，有93%的年份在10月低點後上漲至年底，平均漲幅達7.4%，幾乎是其他11個月份平均漲幅的2倍；研究亦發現，10月並不存在特殊的股市崩盤風險。
根據《MarketWatch》報導，分析認為，市場情緒可能是造成這項季節性現象的關鍵因素。
報導以一群專注於那斯達克市場、由數十名股市擇時操作者組成的樣本為例，觀察他們建議的平均股票曝險比率，因為這部分股市對散戶投資人情緒的變化尤其敏感。
分析顯示，自2000年以來，10月對這部分市場的平均股票曝險比率，僅略高於其他11個月份的一半，分別為13.6%與26.1%。因此，股市自10月低點反彈的現象，正是逆向分析的經典例證。

研究顯示10月並無特殊崩盤風險

更值得注意的是，兩項研究指出，投資人10月降低股票曝險，主要與市場情緒有關，而非當月存在特殊的基本面風險。
其中，哈佛大學經濟學與金融學教授Xavier Gabaix及其共同研究者建立了一套複雜模型，用以估算股市在10月的任何一天出現極端單日崩盤的機率。
研究顯示，任何一個10月出現類似1987年股災、道瓊工業指數單日重挫22.6%的崩盤，機率僅為0.06%；至於出現類似1929年股災、單日下跌12.8%的情況，機率則為0.30%。
同時，Gabaix亦表示，這些極低的崩盤機率適用於所有月份，10月並沒有特殊之處，因此股市歷史上最嚴重的兩次崩盤恰好發生在10月，幾乎可以確定只是巧合。
他表示：「就我們所知，沒有特別理由顯示10月的崩盤機率會高於其他月份。」
另一項顯示股市崩盤風險目前並未升高的研究，則是由哈佛大學的Robin Greenwood與Andrei Shleifer，以及香港大學的Yang You共同進行。他們並未聚焦於單日股市崩盤的發生機率，而是著眼於股市在2年內下跌40%的可能性。
State Street Markets在徵詢Greenwood的意見後，以這項研究為基礎，進一步建立了該公司稱為「美國市場泡沫預測」的指標。根據這項預測的最新更新結果，未來2年美股下跌40%的機率，與歷史平均值相比並無顯著差異。
報導總結稱，整體而言，若投資人僅因10月即將到來，便擔心未來幾週可能爆發股市崩盤，現有研究並不支持這項憂慮。
儘管股市仍可能走跌，但單憑月份進入10月，並不足以認定市場面臨更高的崩盤風險。
paras_en: October has long been viewed as a high‑risk month for a US stock‑market crash, but analysts say investors’ worries about the “October curse” may actually depress market performance and create buying‑the‑dip opportunities. Historical data show that since 1957 the S&P 500 has risen after its October lows in 93% of years, gaining an average of 7.4% by year‑end – roughly twice the average gain of the other eleven months – and research also finds no special crash risk in October.
According to MarketWatch, analysts believe market sentiment may be the key driver of this seasonal pattern.

The report cites a sample of dozens of market‑timing practitioners who focus on the Nasdaq, observing the average equity‑exposure ratios they recommend, because that segment of the market is especially sensitive to retail investor sentiment shifts.

Analysis shows that since 2000 the average equity‑exposure ratio for this segment in October is only slightly higher than the average for the other eleven months – 13.6% versus 26.1% – making the post‑October‑low rebound a classic contrarian example.

Research shows October carries no special crash risk. More notably, two studies find that investors lower equity exposure in October mainly due to sentiment, not because of any unique fundamental risk that month.
Harvard economics and finance professor Xavier Gabaix and co‑authors have built a sophisticated model to estimate the probability of an extreme single‑day crash on any day in October.
The study finds the chance of a crash comparable to the 1987 crash – a 22.6% one‑day drop in the Dow – is only 0.06%, while the probability of a 1929‑type crash – a 12.8% one‑day fall – is 0.30%.

Gabaix also notes that these extremely low crash probabilities apply to all months; October is no different, and the fact that the two worst crashes in history happened in October is almost certainly a coincidence.
He says, “As far as we know, there is no particular reason to think the crash probability in October is higher than in other months.”

Another study showing that crash risk is not currently elevated was conducted by Harvard’s Robin Greenwood and Andrei Shleifer together with Hong Kong University’s Yang You. Rather than focusing on single‑day crash probabilities, they examined the likelihood of a 40% market decline over a two‑year horizon.

After consulting Greenwood, State Street Markets used this research to develop its “U.S. Market Bubble Forecast” indicator. The latest update of that forecast shows the probability of a 40% drop in US equities over the next two years is not significantly different from the historical average.
The report concludes that, overall, existing research does not support the concern that the mere approach of October should make investors fear an imminent market crash in the coming weeks.
While markets can still decline, simply entering the month of October is insufficient to deem the market facing a higher crash risk.

items.title: 美軍要動手了？五角大廈「披薩指數」飆升
items.title_en: US Military About to Act? Pentagon “Pizza Index” Soars
paras: 美國駐中東多國大使館19日（周六）發布安全警示，稱當前安全環境出現不可預見的升級風險，同日美國「披薩指數」追蹤網站發布的數據顯示，五角大廈附近的披薩店當天訂單數激增。
「披薩指數」追蹤網站連續發帖，稱五角大廈旁最近的披薩店於18日22時和19日17時訂單激增，客流量均顯著高於往日相同時段。
「披薩指數」通過追蹤五角大廈附近披薩店的訂單數推測美國國防部是否加班，藉此預測美國軍事行動。在「沙漠風暴」、美軍空襲伊朗核設施等軍事行動前，五角大廈附近披薩店曾出現訂單激增的情況。
美國駐巴林、阿曼、阿聯、沙烏地阿拉伯、卡達、科威特、約旦、以色列、黎巴嫩、伊拉克等國使館19日發布安全警示，稱中東安全環境依然複雜，面臨不可預見的升級風險。
據美國《Axios》等媒體報導，當天晚上美國總統川普縮短度假行程，提前一天從度假地戴維營返回白宮。
據美國《CNN》報導，川普在戴維營評估了打擊葉門叛軍胡塞的各項方案，外界認為「披薩指數」飆升可能與此有關。
paras_en: The U.S. embassies in several Middle Eastern countries issued a security alert on Saturday the 19th, warning that the current security environment carries an unpredictable risk of escalation. On the same day, data from the U.S. “Pizza Index” tracking site showed a sharp surge in orders at pizza shops near the Pentagon.

The “Pizza Index” tracking site posted repeatedly, noting that the nearest pizza shop to the Pentagon saw order spikes at 10 p.m. on the 18th and again at 5 p.m. on the 19th, with foot traffic significantly higher than usual for those time slots.

The “Pizza Index” infers whether the Department of Defense is pulling overtime by monitoring order volumes at nearby pizza restaurants, using the metric to forecast U.S. military actions. Similar order surges have preceded operations such as “Desert Storm” and U.S. air strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities.

U.S. embassies in Bahrain, Oman, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Jordan, Israel, Lebanon and Iraq released a security alert on the 19th, stating that the Middle‑East security environment remains complex and faces an unpredictable risk of escalation.
According to U.S. media outlets such as Axios, that evening President Donald Trump cut short his vacation, returning to the White House a day early from his retreat at Camp David.
CNN reported that Trump evaluated various options for striking the Houthi rebels in Yemen while at Camp David, and observers think the surge in the “Pizza Index” may be linked to that assessment.

items.title: 首超GPU！小摩：2027年ASIC/XPU佔比54% 今年客製化AI ASIC規模約600-700億美元
items.title_en: Top GPU No More! JPMorgan: ASIC/XPU Share to Reach 54% in 2027, Custom AI ASIC Market About $60‑70 B This Year
paras: 摩根大通(下稱小摩)最新半導體報告預估，AI加速器出貨結構將在2027年出現拐點，ASIC/XPU佔比由今年約41%升至54%，首次超過通用GPU，2028年再升至55%。若按數量估算，2027年ASIC/XPU約1250萬顆、GPU約1090萬顆。
報告同時估計，今年客製化AI ASIC市場規模約600億至700億美元，未來數年的年複合成長率超過40%至50%，成為半導體景氣核心增量。
驅動力來自雲端廠商自研趨勢。谷歌TPU、亞馬遜Trainium、微軟Maia、Meta MTIA等XPU針對大規模推理、推薦、訓練特定負載優化，目標是壓低每token成本、功耗與對通用GPU的單一依賴。
相較於「萬能」GPU，ASIC犧牲通用性換取能效與總擁有成本。小摩指出，這不是GPU被替代，而是AI基礎設施由「通用為主」轉向「GPU訓練＋客製化晶片規模化推理」雙軌。
目前，博通與邁威爾科技合計佔客製化AI ASIC市場約90%，其中博通約80%至85%，受益於谷歌長期TPU、Meta、OpenAI等客戶設計服務，邁威爾則大約10%至12%，涵蓋亞馬遜、微軟、谷歌部分互連與記憶體附加晶片。
小摩在報告中特別說明，谷歌TPU等供應鏈資訊不透明不等同訂單走弱，博通與谷歌5年協議涵蓋2026至2031年，橫跨3奈米、2奈米與先進封裝，並有逐年遞增營收安排，收入可見度較強。後續觀察點在2奈米產能、CoWoS/先進封裝、HBM配貨及雲端廠商自研量產節奏。若ASIC出貨如期過半，博通、邁威爾及周邊IP、先進封裝鏈將持續受惠，但客戶自研比例提升也會在中長期削弱設計服務商議價空間。
paras_en: JPMorgan (referred to as JPM) estimates in its latest semiconductor report that the AI accelerator shipment mix will hit a turning point in 2027, with ASIC/XPU share rising from roughly 41% this year to 54%, overtaking general‑purpose GPUs for the first time, and climbing to 55% in 2028. In unit terms, JPM projects about 12.5 million ASIC/XPU chips and 10.9 million GPUs shipped in 2027.

The report also estimates the custom AI ASIC market size at about $60 billion to $70 billion this year, with a compound annual growth rate of over 40%‑50% in the coming years, making it a core growth driver for the semiconductor cycle.

The driver is the cloud providers’ trend toward in‑house designs. Google’s TPU, Amazon’s Trainium, Microsoft’s Maia and Meta’s MTIA are XPU products optimized for large‑scale inference, recommendation and training workloads, aiming to lower per‑token cost, power consumption and dependence on general‑purpose GPUs.

Compared with the “universal” GPU, ASICs sacrifice flexibility for higher energy efficiency and lower total cost of ownership. JPM notes this is not a replacement of GPUs, but a shift of AI infrastructure from a “general‑purpose‑dominant” model to a dual‑track approach of “GPU training plus mass‑scale inference on custom chips.”

Currently Broadcom and Marvell together account for roughly 90% of the custom AI ASIC market, with Broadcom holding about 80%‑85% thanks to long‑term TPU, Meta, OpenAI and other customer design services, while Marvell captures about 10%‑12%, covering parts of Amazon, Microsoft and Google interconnect and memory‑side chips.

JPM specifically points out that opaque supply‑chain information for Google’s TPU does not imply weakening orders. Broadcom’s five‑year agreement with Google, covering 2026‑2031 and spanning 3 nm, 2 nm and advanced packaging, includes stepped‑up revenue targets, giving strong visibility. Future watch points include 2 nm capacity, CoWoS/advanced packaging, HBM allocation and the production pace of cloud providers’ in‑house designs. If ASIC shipments reach the projected share, Broadcom, Marvell and related IP, advanced‑packaging chains will continue to benefit, though a higher proportion of customer‑developed chips could erode design‑service firms’ bargaining power in the medium to long term.

items.title: 官方統計：受戰爭影響 伊朗經濟萎縮10%
items.title_en: Official Statistics: Iran's Economy Shrinks 10% Due to War
paras: 據《法新社》報導，自2月下旬美國與以色列發動襲擊以來，伊朗經濟萎縮約10%。
伊朗統計中心20日（周日）發布的數據顯示，從3月下旬到6月下旬（伊朗稱之為波斯曆第一季），國內生產總額（GDP）較去年同期下降10.1%。
自2月下旬以來，伊朗一直與美國處於戰爭狀態。當時美國和以色列的空襲導致伊朗最高領袖和多名高階軍官喪生，拉開了大規模攻勢序幕。
這些襲擊引發伊朗封鎖荷姆茲海峽的報復行動，隨後全球石油價格飆漲，衝突也蔓延至中東。
除戰爭因素之外，伊朗經濟受美國長期制裁影響，一直飽受惡性通貨膨脹和貨幣貶值困擾。
卡達外交部發言人馬吉德·安薩里20日表示，卡達正與美國和伊朗保持溝通，推動美伊恢復談判。他說，多名美國政府官員表示，美方希望達成協議，結束衝突。
安薩里在美國紐約舉行的卡達經濟論壇期間表示，過去幾周卡達一直與美國和伊朗交換意見，努力彌合分歧，但他沒有給出談判恢復的時間表。
他說：「我們聽到多名美國政府官員表態，確認美國希望達成協議，希望找到結束這場戰爭的解決方案。」
安薩里表示，任何解決方案都應確保中東穩定，同時推動國際社會就保護包括荷姆茲海峽在內的戰略水道達成共識。他指出，曼德海峽目前也受到中東衝突影響。
paras_en: According to AFP, Iran’s economy has contracted by about 10% since the United States and Israel launched attacks in late February.
Data released by Iran’s Statistical Center on Sunday the 20th shows that from late March to late June (the first quarter of the Persian calendar), gross domestic product fell 10.1% year‑on‑year.

Iran has been in a state of war with the United States since late February, when U.S. and Israeli airstrikes killed the Iranian Supreme Leader’s top aide and several senior military officers, kicking off a large‑scale offensive.
The strikes prompted Iran to retaliate by closing the Strait of Hormuz, after which global oil prices surged and the conflict spread across the Middle East.
Beyond the war, Iran’s economy has long been hampered by U.S. sanctions, suffering from runaway inflation and a depreciating currency.

Qatar’s foreign ministry spokesperson Majid Al‑Ansari said on the 20th that Qatar is maintaining communications with the United States and Iran to push for the resumption of U.S.–Iran talks, noting that several U.S. officials have expressed a desire to reach an agreement and end the fighting.

Speaking at the Qatar Economic Forum in New York, Al‑Ansari said Qatar has been exchanging views with the United States and Iran over the past weeks to bridge differences, but he gave no timeline for the restart of negotiations.
He added, “We have heard multiple U.S. officials state that the United States wants to reach a deal and find a solution to end this war.”

Al‑Ansari said any solution must ensure stability in the Middle East while encouraging the international community to reach consensus on protecting strategic waterways, including the Strait of Hormuz, and noted that the Strait of Mand is also being affected by the regional conflict.

items.title: 特斯拉機器人團隊在長三角審廠 多家企業接獲訂單
items.title_en: Tesla Robot Team Conducts Factory Audits in the Yangtze River Delta; Multiple Companies Receive Orders
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 機器人團隊落地寧波審廠一事受資本市場關注，產業鏈人士透露，特斯拉機器人團隊上周已於拓普集團(601689-CN) 、三花智控(02050-HK) 、均勝電子(600699-CN) 等供應鏈企業開啟審廠工作。
上述企業主要供給關節模組、執行器、精密結構件等核心機電部件。
「在本次審廠前，這些企業都已經拿到了特斯拉人形機器人的訂單，只是或多或少的區別。審廠將對相關產線品質、合規等方面展開評估，通過後將很快開始生產。」上述人士提到。
據《澎湃新聞》21日（周一）報導，該名產業鏈人士表示，審廠工作並非網傳的只在寧波展開，特斯拉該機器人團隊本次走訪工作還覆蓋杭州、上海等長三角地區供應鏈企業。相關企業基本也都是特斯拉已經有合作的供應鏈企業。
此前有消息稱，特斯拉計劃在今年生產數千台人形機器人。供應鏈審廠工作開啟，意味著特斯拉人形機器人量產工作更進一步。
特斯拉即將開啟量產的是第三代人形機器人，也是其第一款量產機型，相比前代，重點升級手部靈巧機構、關節執行器，優先承擔工廠內物料搬運、簡單流水線輔助等工業任務。單機長期目標成本為2萬～3萬美元。
產能方面，特斯拉原Model S/X生產線已經轉型為特斯拉人形機器人專用生產線，規劃年產能達100萬台。
同時，特斯拉正在德州超級工廠準備機器人第二條產線，長期設計年產能為1,000萬台，預計明年夏季左右投產。馬斯克稱人形機器人量產是特斯拉有史以來量產難度最大的產品。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) robot team’s factory audit in Ningbo has drawn attention from the capital markets. Industry insiders say the team began audits last week at supply‑chain firms including Top Group (601689-CN), SFA Control (02050-HK) and Joyson Electronics (600699-CN).
These companies mainly supply core electromechanical parts such as joint modules, actuators and precision structural components.

"Before these audits, all of these firms had already secured orders for Tesla’s humanoid robot, albeit with varying specifications. The audits will assess production‑line quality, compliance and other factors, and once passed, production will start quickly," the insider said.

According to a report by The Paper on Monday the 21st, the insider clarified that the audits are not limited to Ningbo as online rumors suggest; Tesla’s robot team is also visiting supply‑chain companies in Hangzhou, Shanghai and other parts of the Yangtze River Delta. The firms involved are essentially those already partnered with Tesla.

Earlier reports indicated that Tesla plans to produce several thousand humanoid robots this year. The launch of supply‑chain audits signals that mass production of the robots is moving a step further forward.

Tesla is about to begin mass production of its third‑generation humanoid robot, which will also be its first mass‑produced model. Compared with earlier versions, it features upgraded hand dexterity mechanisms and joint actuators, and will initially handle material handling and simple assembly‑line assistance tasks in factories. The long‑term target cost per unit is $20,000‑$30,000.
In terms of capacity, Tesla’s former Model S/X production line has been converted into a dedicated line for the humanoid robot, with a planned annual output of up to one million units.

At the same time, Tesla is preparing a second robot production line at its Texas Gigafactory, designed for a long‑term annual capacity of 10 million units and expected to start up around summer next year. Elon Musk says mass‑producing the humanoid robot will be the most challenging product Tesla has ever manufactured.

items.title: 日賺2.4億人民幣！「寧王」賺很大   苦哈哈的中國車廠正集體「重新談判」
items.title_en: Earn 240 million RMB a Day! “King Ning” Rakes in Huge Profits – Chinese Automakers Are Collectively “Renegotiating”
paras: 「電動車電池成本佔整車成本六成，車廠事實上是在為電池廠打工」，這句話是幾年前時任廣汽集團董事長曾慶洪的感慨，但在今年中國車市卻顯得格外刺耳。
根據中汽協數據，今年上半年中國整車製造環節平均利潤率跌至1.5%，創近十年低，以單車均價約20.2萬元(人民幣，下同)折算，整車廠僅留下約3000元歸母淨利潤。與此同時，寧德時代今年上半年歸母淨利為432.84億元，較去年成長41.98%，折合日均淨賺近2.4億元。
數據顯示，一家電池供應商的獲利，與絕大多數車廠加總相當，這就是當下產業鏈利潤分配的真實圖景。

車廠動手也不再遮掩，9月成為車廠重構電池供應的密集窗口期。理想汽車9月4日宣布以26.5億元增資欣旺達動力，認購增資完成後8.79%股份，疊加既有持股，相關主體合計持有約11.17%，成為第二大股東；9月7日，理想宣布自研5C電池已在L8、L6、i8三款車型量產，後續涵蓋全系，新一代MEGA、i9、i6三款新車先行切換，其中i6標配自研5C電池。理想汽車指出，電芯由欣旺達、中創新航代工，理想主導材料配方、結構體系、BMS底層開發與統一品質標準，即「自研不自製」。
此外，小米汽車推出「龍甲電池」系統方案，由小米主導產品定義與電池包設計，中創新航、欣旺達按小米標準定制生產電芯；小鵬汽車則把動力電池技術落地轉為自主主導，引入億緯鋰能等二供，分散採購份額。
傳統車廠亦未缺席：零跑在9月技術日宣布實現電池100%全域自研自製，以L148、L208、L300三款標準電芯覆蓋全系；鴻蒙智行引入中創新航、國軒高科、欣旺達三家供應商。
降低單一依賴是各大中國車廠同一路徑，奪回電池環節的定價權與定義權。產業分析家邱鍇俊直指，供應商毛利非常高，車企自然會想「往上擠壓出一點毛利率來」。
根據SNE Research統計，今年前5月寧德時代全球動力電池使用量達188.4GWh，年增22.9%，市佔率40.2%，年比提升2.2個百分點，連9年全球第一；上半年全球裝車量242.7GWh，為第二名的2.8倍。國內市佔率亦回升至46.04%，為近三年首次回升。寧德時代首席製造長倪軍的回應延續其一貫口徑：「會造車，不一定會造電池，還是要專業的人做專業的事」。
「去寧化」的實際落點在中低端市場，10萬元以下車型寧德時代份額僅約22%，吉利星願、比亞迪海鷗、五菱繽果等爆款主要採用蜂巢能源、弗迪電池、國軒高科產品；而在20萬元以上中高端市場，其份額超過60%，賽力斯、理想、寶馬、小米市佔重要客戶，三元電池市場佔7%。多數車企採取分車型、分階段的梯度切換，而非一刀切替代。
最有意味的細節是有人「賣廠」給寧德時代。根據中國國家市場監理總局公告，寧德時代收購重慶耀寧新能源股權案已於9月3日審結，參與集中的經營者為寧德時代與極氪汽車（上海）有限公司，標的為吉利體系規劃年產能18GWh、原定2026年底試生產的在建動力電池項目。吉利明確回應稱為正常的資產優化，不影響自研策略，也不意味著退出電池業務。
這項動作反向印證了造電池的門檻：產能規模、良率控制、技術迭代與供應鏈管理均需長期積累，二線廠商在高端快充與海外配套上短期內難以完全替代。但這並不消解車訴求。只要電池成本佔比不降、利潤分配格局不改，議價動力就持續存在。產業權力不會固定在某一方，「寧王」需要從掌控產品供給，轉向與下游車廠共生。
paras_en: “Battery costs account for 60% of an EV’s total cost, so automakers are essentially working for battery makers,” said Zeng Qinghong, then chairman of GAC Group, a remark that now sounds especially harsh in this year’s Chinese car market.

According to data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, the average profit margin for vehicle manufacturers fell to 1.5% in the first half of this year – the lowest in a decade. With an average vehicle price of about 202,000 RMB, that leaves roughly 3,000 RMB of net profit per car for the OEM. By contrast, CATL posted a net profit attributable to shareholders of 43.284 billion RMB for the same period, up 41.98% year‑on‑year, which works out to almost 240 million RMB of net earnings per day.

The figures show that the profit of a single battery supplier can match the combined earnings of the vast majority of automakers – a vivid illustration of how profit is currently distributed along the supply chain.

Automakers are no longer hiding their moves. September has become an intensive window for reshaping battery supply. On September 4, Li Auto announced a 2.65 billion RMB capital increase in XW Power, acquiring an 8.79% stake post‑increase; together with its existing holdings, Li now controls about 11.17% and becomes the second‑largest shareholder. On September 7, Li disclosed that its self‑developed 5C battery is already in mass production for the L8, L6 and i8 models and will soon cover the entire lineup, with the next‑generation MEGA, i9 and i6 models switching to it first – the i6 will come standard with the 5C battery. Li said the cells are manufactured by XW Power and Zhongchuang Xin Hang, while Li leads material formulation, cell architecture, BMS development and unified quality standards – “self‑developed, not self‑manufactured.”

In addition, Xiaomi Auto launched its “Longjia” battery system, with Xiaomi defining the product and pack design while Zhongchuang Xin Hang and XW Power produce cells to Xiaomi’s specifications. Meanwhile, XPeng is turning its power‑battery technology into an in‑house capability, bringing in secondary suppliers such as Yiwei Lithium Energy to diversify its procurement share.

Traditional automakers are also active: Leapmotor announced on its September technology day that it has achieved 100% global self‑research and self‑manufacture of batteries, covering its entire range with three standard cells – L148, L208 and L300. Hongmeng Smart Mobility has added Zhongchuang Xin Hang, Guoxuan High‑Tech and XW Power as suppliers.

Reducing reliance on a single source is a common strategy among Chinese OEMs, aimed at reclaiming pricing and specification power over the battery segment. Industry analyst Qiu Kaijun bluntly noted that supplier gross margins are extremely high, so automakers naturally want to “squeeze out a bit of margin” for themselves.

According to SNE Research, CATL’s global power‑battery usage reached 188.4 GWh in the first five months of this year, up 22.9% year‑on‑year, giving it a 40.2% market share – a 2.2‑percentage‑point increase and the top global position for the ninth consecutive year. Global vehicle installations in the first half totaled 242.7 GWh, 2.8 times that of the second‑largest player. Its domestic share rose to 46.04%, the first rise in three years. CATL’s chief manufacturing officer Ni Jun reiterated the company’s stance: “We can make cars, but we don’t necessarily make batteries; professionals should do professional work.”

The “de‑CATL‑ization” is most evident in the low‑end segment: for cars priced below 100,000 RMB, CATL’s share is only about 22%, with popular models such as Geely Xingyuan, BYD Haiou and Wuling Bingo using batteries from Hive Energy, Fudi and Guoxuan High‑Tech. In the mid‑to‑high‑end market above 200,000 RMB, CATL’s share exceeds 60%, serving key customers like Seres, Li Auto, BMW and Xiaomi, while ternary‑cell batteries account for 7% of the market. Most OEMs adopt a phased, model‑by‑model transition rather than a wholesale replacement.

A noteworthy detail is that a “factory” was sold to CATL. According to an announcement from China’s State Administration for Market Regulation, CATL’s acquisition of a stake in Chongqing Yaoning New Energy was approved on September 3. The transaction involved CATL and Zeekr (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., targeting a GEELY‑planned 18 GWh annual‑capacity power‑battery project that was under construction and slated for trial production by the end of 2026. Geely clarified that the deal is a normal asset‑optimization move, does not affect its own R&D strategy, and does not signal an exit from the battery business.

This move underscores the high barriers to battery manufacturing: large‑scale capacity, yield control, technology iteration and supply‑chain management all require long‑term accumulation, and second‑tier players cannot quickly replace top‑tier suppliers in high‑speed charging or overseas support. Nevertheless, the pressure on automakers remains. As long as battery cost share and profit‑distribution patterns stay unchanged, bargaining power will persist. Industry power will not be locked to a single side; “King Ning” will need to shift from merely controlling product supply to co‑existing symbiotically with downstream automakers.

items.title: 俄烏戰爭持續升級！傳川普周二見澤倫斯基  基輔稱「可能改變很多事情」　冬季降級方案有譜？
items.title_en: War in Ukraine Escalates as Trump Expected to Meet Zelensky on Tuesday; Kyiv Says It Could Change Many Things, Winter De‑escalation Plan Questioned
paras: 外電最新報導指出，美國總統川普與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基預計本周在紐約聯合國大會期間舉行會談，恰逢華府同步加碼對俄制裁、擴大對烏軍售，而俄烏遠程打擊卻持續升級的張力之際。基輔方面稱此會「恐改變很多事情」，但華府推動的冬季降級方案，首先要過的就是能源設施互炸這一關。
澤倫斯基周(20)日與川普通話後宣布，雙方已同意在紐約會面。烏克蘭總統府表示，議程將涵蓋可能的戰場降級、能源安全、糧食安全與人員問題，烏國準備採取「真正嚴肅的步驟」。
《路透社》引述知情人士消息報導指出，「川澤會」預計於周二(22日)舉行，白宮迄今尚未公開確認具體時間，但川普紐約行已日安排多場雙邊會見與參加聯合國大會活動。
會談前有兩項烏克蘭長期爭取的美國政策落地。上周五(18日)，川普簽署《林賽·O·格雷厄姆制裁俄羅斯和伊朗法案》，擴大對俄能源、國防產業及規避制裁的「影子船隊」限制，並授權對俄國主要能源貿易夥伴加徵最高100%關稅，並同時延長對伊朗相關制裁，試圖把能源與地緣壓力一併綁緊。
美國國務院上周五也批准最高約27億美元潛在對烏軍售，內容包括防空飛彈、系統升級組件、發射裝置改裝與反無人機雷達等，重點補強烏國防空與反無人機體系，此潛在軍售案仍須美國國會審查，資金擬由歐洲出資與既有美國對外軍事融資共同承擔。
制裁與軍售並行，使華府對基輔、莫斯科形成「一手促談、一手加壓」的雙軌。川普特使威科夫、女婿庫許納本月先後訪問俄烏，烏國稱這讓原先停滯的談判重啟。
美國網媒《Axios》報導，澤倫斯基首席談判代表烏梅羅夫表示，主要分歧已從數十項縮至「一兩個關鍵問題」，但未說明內容。
但戰場上並未降溫。俄國首都莫斯科及周邊周日遭大規模無人機攻擊。俄國稱自上周六(19日)起攔截超過1600架，其中約450架飛向莫斯科方向，部分突破防禦擊中一座煉油廠與住宅設施，莫斯科州方面稱至少3人死亡。
由於攻擊發生當天適逢俄國國會選舉最後一天，莫斯科指責基輔意圖干擾投票，基輔則拒絕承認俄佔區選舉合法性。烏國未就俄方傷亡與攔截數字單獨回應。被擊中的莫斯科煉油廠是俄國內重要燃料設施，烏克蘭過去一年持續打擊俄煉油、儲油與能源物流，目標在削減俄石油收入與軍隊燃料供應。
與此同時，俄軍繼續對烏國城市、電網與港口發動遠程打擊，雙方形成「俄打烏基礎設施、烏打俄能源縱深」的循環。能源設施因而成為「川澤會」中最具體的爭論點。
《Axios》引述知情人士報導指出，川普多次要求澤倫斯基停止襲擊俄國煉油廠，憂心相關攻擊削減俄燃油供應、推升全球柴油價格。澤倫斯基則重申，若俄停止攻擊烏能源等關鍵設施，基輔願相應停手。
華府的冬季降級方案亦打算納入互限能源基礎設施攻擊，但既有互限安排屢因雙方相互指責違約而失效，川、澤周二會談的實質考驗是能否建立可執行、可核查的互惠機制，而非再簽一份很快破功的政治承諾。
paras_en: Foreign reports say U.S. President Trump and Ukrainian President Zelensky are slated to meet in New York during the UN General Assembly this week, coinciding with Washington’s tightening of sanctions on Russia and expanding arms sales to Ukraine, while Russia‑Ukraine long‑range strikes continue to intensify. Kyiv says the meeting could "change a lot," but the White House’s winter de‑escalation plan first has to overcome the hurdle of mutual attacks on energy facilities.

Zelensky announced on the 20th, after a Mandarin‑language call with Trump, that both sides have agreed to meet in New York. The Ukrainian presidential office said the agenda will cover possible battlefield de‑escalation, energy security, food security and personnel issues, and Ukraine is ready to take "truly serious steps."

Reuters, citing informed sources, reported that the "Trump‑Zelensky" meeting is expected on Tuesday the 22nd; the White House has not yet disclosed a specific time, but Trump’s New York schedule already includes multiple bilateral meetings and participation in UNGA events.

Ahead of the talks, two long‑sought U.S. policies for Ukraine are being implemented. Last Friday the 18th, Trump signed the Lindsey O. Graham Act to sanction Russia and Iran, expanding restrictions on Russia’s energy, defense sectors and its “shadow fleet,” authorising up to a 100% tariff on major Russian energy trade partners and extending sanctions on Iran, aiming to tighten energy and geopolitical pressure together.

The U.S. State Department also approved potential arms sales to Ukraine worth up to about $2.7 billion last Friday, including air‑defence missiles, system upgrade components, launch‑device modifications and anti‑drone radars, aimed at bolstering Ukraine’s air‑defence and anti‑drone capabilities. The sale still requires congressional review and funding is expected to be shared between Europe and existing U.S. foreign‑military financing.

The parallel sanctions and arms sales give Washington a “talk‑and‑press” two‑track approach toward Kyiv and Moscow. Trump envoys Wike and his son‑in‑law Kushner visited Russia and Ukraine earlier this month, which Kyiv says has revived stalled negotiations.
Axios reported that Ukraine’s chief negotiator Mykhailo Meller said the main differences have been narrowed from dozens to “one or two key issues,” without specifying what they are.

But fighting on the ground shows no sign of cooling. Moscow and surrounding regions suffered a large‑scale drone attack on Sunday. Russia says it intercepted more than 1,600 drones since Saturday the 19th, about 450 of which were headed toward Moscow, with some breaching defenses to hit a refinery and residential facilities; Moscow region officials said at least three people were killed.

Because the attack occurred on the final day of Russia’s parliamentary election, Moscow accused Kyiv of trying to disrupt voting, while Kyiv rejected the legitimacy of elections in Russian‑occupied territories. Ukraine did not comment separately on Russian casualty or interception figures. The hit refinery is a key fuel asset; Ukraine has spent the past year repeatedly striking Russian refineries, storage sites and energy logistics to cut Russian oil revenue and military fuel supplies.

At the same time, Russian forces continue long‑range strikes on Ukrainian cities, power grids and ports, creating a cycle where Russia hits Ukrainian infrastructure and Ukraine hits Russian energy depth. Energy facilities have thus become the most concrete point of contention in the "Trump‑Zelensky" talks.

Axios, citing informed sources, said Trump has repeatedly asked Zelensky to stop attacks on Russian refineries, fearing such strikes would cut Russian fuel supplies and push up global diesel prices. Zelensky reiterated that if Russia ceases attacks on Ukrainian energy and other critical sites, Kyiv is willing to halt its own strikes.

The White House’s winter de‑escalation plan also aims to include mutual limits on attacks against energy infrastructure, but existing reciprocal arrangements have repeatedly collapsed amid mutual accusations of breach. The real test of the Tuesday Trump‑Zelensky meeting is whether they can forge an enforceable, verifiable reciprocal mechanism, rather than merely signing another quickly‑broken political pledge.

items.title: 高市早苗搶在川習會前見川普 原因與台灣有關
items.title_en: Sanae Koike Seizes a Pre‑Summit Meeting with Trump Over Taiwan Concerns
paras: 美國總統川普將於周二(22日)在紐約與日本首相高市早苗舉行會談，時間早於24日在華盛頓登場的川習會。即使可能面臨防衛支出、駐日美軍經費與財政政策等壓力，日本仍積極促成這場會談，關鍵就在於東京擔憂川普為取得政治成果，可能在台灣、東海與南海等問題上對中國讓步。
搶先向川普劃下紅線
美國常駐聯合國大使華茲18日透露，高市將在赴美出席聯合國大會期間與川普會面。美國政府高層表示，日本是極其重要的盟國與區域夥伴，在中國國家主席習近平訪美前，這將是一場重要會談。
高市預料將向川普重申日本對中國的立場，強調面對中國在軍事與經濟上的施壓，美方必須堅持不允許以武力片面改變現狀，並避免在台灣等議題上輕易退讓。
川普與習近平預計今年內舉行三場會談，除此次華盛頓峰會外，11月與12月還有亞太經合組織（APEC）領袖非正式會議及二十國集團（G20）峰會。川普政府面臨11月中期選舉，急於取得可向選民展示的成果，使日本更加警戒美中之間可能出現政治交易。
日本擔心，美國可能以中國擴大進口美國商品為條件，接受中方在台灣、東海及南海等議題上的部分主張。因此，高市選擇在中美峰會前先與川普會談，希望提前傳達日本的安全關切，避免華府政策轉向對中緩和。
明知有風險仍要見
這場會談對日本並非沒有代價。美國正敦促盟國將核心防衛支出提高至國內生產毛額（GDP）的3.5%，日本年底修訂安保相關三文件時，可能面臨進一步增加防衛費的要求。
日美年底前也將討論每五年修訂一次的駐日美軍駐留經費，也就是俗稱的「體貼預算」。日本政府內部擔憂，美方可能要求日方大幅提高對美軍設施人員費及水電燃氣費等支出。
美方也可能對日本經濟與財政政策提出要求。美國認為日本利率上升可能波及美國利率，因此要求日本維持財政紀律並推進升息。日本政府除研議調降消費稅，也計畫增加公私部門逾370兆日元的成長投資與防衛支出，年底編列預算時仍須交代資金來源。
若日本無法提出穩定降低債務占GDP比重的路徑，可能動搖市場信心，進一步推升長期利率並加劇日元貶值。換言之，高市與川普會面，也可能讓日本面臨更多來自美方的要求。
對美風險管理成執政關鍵
即使如此，日本仍極力安排高市搶在中美峰會前與川普會談，反映東京對川普可能轉向對中緩和的高度警戒。
高市日前進行內閣改組時，留任財務相片山皋月、經濟產業相赤澤亮正、外相茂木敏充及防衛相小泉進次郎等負責對美事務的重要閣員，理由正是外交與貿易工作需要維持與外國政府的人脈及政策延續性。
高市並要求內閣以日美同盟為基石，由日本主導推動自由開放的印太地區，同時強化日美韓、日美菲、日美澳及日美印等多邊防衛合作，藉此維持美國對印太事務的參與。
對高市政府而言，川普把同盟關係視為成本與交易，日本既要防止美國在中國問題上讓步，也必須承受華府對防衛、駐軍經費及財政政策的壓力。如何管理來自美國的風險，已成為高市執政的一項關鍵考驗。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump will meet Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Koike on Tuesday (the 22nd) in New York, a meeting that comes before the Trump‑Xi summit scheduled for the 24th in Washington. Even though Japan may face pressure over defense spending, U.S. forces‑based costs and fiscal policy, Tokyo is actively pushing for the talks, fearing that Trump might concede to China on Taiwan, the East China Sea and the South China Sea in order to secure political wins.
Pre‑emptively drawing a red line for Trump

U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations, Linda Thomas‑Greenfield, said on the 18th that Koike will meet Trump while she is in New York for the UN General Assembly. senior U.S. officials noted that Japan is an extremely important ally and regional partner, and that the meeting will be a key dialogue before Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to the United States.

Koike is expected to reaffirm Japan’s stance toward China, stressing that in the face of Beijing’s military and economic pressure, the United States must insist that force cannot unilaterally change the status quo and that concessions on Taiwan and related issues should not be made lightly.

Trump and Xi are slated to hold three meetings this year – besides the Washington summit, there will be an informal APEC leaders’ meeting in November and a G20 summit in December. With a mid‑term election looming in November, the Trump administration is eager for achievements it can showcase to voters, making Japan even more wary of any political deal‑making between Washington and Beijing.

Japan worries that the United States could tie expanded Chinese imports of U.S. goods to concessions on Taiwan, the East China Sea and the South China Sea. Consequently, Koike chose to meet Trump before the U.S.–China summit to convey Japan’s security concerns early and to try to prevent a policy shift in Washington that would ease pressure on China.
Knowing the risks but still pressing ahead

The meeting is not without cost for Japan. The United States is urging allies to raise core defense spending to 3.5% of GDP, and Japan may face additional demands to increase its defense budget when it revises its three security‑related documents at the end of the year.

By year‑end, the U.S. and Japan will also discuss the five‑year‑cycle “host nation support” budget for U.S. forces stationed in Japan, commonly called the “comfort budget.” Japanese officials fear Washington may demand a substantial hike in Japan’s contributions for U.S. facility, personnel and utility costs.

Washington could also press Japan on economic and fiscal policy. The United States argues that higher Japanese interest rates could spill over into U.S. rates, so it wants Japan to maintain fiscal discipline and continue raising rates. In addition to considering a consumption‑tax cut, Japan plans to boost public‑private investment and defense spending by more than ¥370 trillion, and must explain funding sources in its year‑end budget.

If Japan cannot present a credible path to steadily lower its debt‑to‑GDP ratio, market confidence could falter, pushing up long‑term yields and deepening yen depreciation. In other words, Koike’s meeting with Trump could expose Japan to even more U.S. demands.
Risk management toward the United States becomes a governing priority
Nevertheless, Japan is vigorously arranging for Koike to meet Trump before the U.S.–China summit, reflecting Tokyo’s heightened vigilance against any possible U.S. softening toward China.

When Koike reshuffled her cabinet, she retained key ministers handling U.S. affairs – Finance Minister Shigeyuki Goto, Economy Minister Ryosuke Akazawa, Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi and Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi – because diplomatic and trade work requires continuity of contacts and policies with foreign governments.

Koike has instructed her cabinet to base the Japan‑U.S. alliance as a cornerstone, to lead a free‑and‑open Indo‑Pacific, and to strengthen multilateral defense cooperation with South Korea, the Philippines, Australia and India, thereby keeping U.S. engagement in Indo‑Pacific affairs.

For Koike’s administration, Trump treats the alliance as a cost‑benefit transaction; Japan must both prevent U.S. concessions on China‑related issues and absorb Washington’s pressure on defense spending, host‑nation costs and fiscal policy. Managing the risk from the United States has become a critical test for Koike’s rule.

items.title: 「補丁海嘯」來襲！花旗執行長：AI風險上升  企業加速進入防禦競賽
items.title_en: "Patch Tsunami" Hits! Citigroup CEO: AI Risks Rising as Companies Accelerate Into a Defense Race
paras: 花旗集團執行長Jane Fraser最新表示，隨著AI模型能力不斷增強，企業正在加速建立防禦體系，以應對可能增加的網路攻擊風險。
Fraser周日(20日)在紐約舉行的卡達經濟論壇上說：「目前全球所有企業都在進行大量補丁修復，形成了一場防禦競賽。」
她表示，今年稍早Anthropic推出的Mythos模型引發了對新一代AI網路風險的關注，之後美國財長貝森特跟時任Fed主席的鮑爾曾召集華爾街高管討論該模型帶來的風險，並敦促企業加強系統防護。
近期，包括谷歌和Anthropic在內的AI系統在測試中出現入侵企業系統的情況，進一步引發安全疑慮。
對此，與會的卡達首相穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿勒薩尼表示，該國正與AI企業合作進行負責任投資，目前圍繞該技術的安全保障措施仍在改善過程中。
此外，Fraser在論壇上還指出，AI發展的瓶頸已經從晶片轉向能源供應，全球對能源需求正在大幅增加。
paras_en: Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser said that as AI model capabilities continue to improve, companies are speeding up the building of defensive systems to cope with potentially higher cyber‑attack risk.
Speaking at the Qatar Economic Forum in New York on Sunday the 20th, Fraser said, "Currently every company worldwide is undertaking massive patch remediation, creating a defense race."

She noted that earlier this year Anthropic’s launch of the Mythos model sparked concerns about a new generation of AI‑related cyber risks, after which U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen and then‑Fed Chair Jerome Powell convened Wall Street executives to discuss the model’s dangers and urged firms to strengthen system protections.
Recent tests have shown AI systems, including those from Google and Anthropic, breaching corporate networks, further raising security worries.

In response, Qatar’s Prime Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al‑Thani said the country is partnering with AI firms on responsible investment, and that safety measures surrounding the technology are still being refined.
Fraser also pointed out at the forum that the bottleneck for AI development has shifted from chips to energy supply, with global energy demand soaring sharply.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】日本如預期升息，日圓走勢震盪
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Japan Raises Rates as Expected, Yen Volatility
paras: ◆USD/JPY

上週五據日本官方公布數據顯示，8月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)同比上漲1.7%，同時日本央行(BOJ)重視的剔除波動較大的生鮮食品和燃料價格的物價指標同比亦上漲1.9%，核心通脹率維持在BOJ目標2%附近，凸顯日益加劇的價格壓力，另外日本央行一如普遍預計將利率上調至三十一年最高的1.25%，並暗示準備繼續推高借貸成本，加入其他主要央行應對油價飆升引發的持續通脹壓力行列，這也是BOJ近三個月來首次加息，這將使利率更接近BOJ認為的中性水平，也標誌著BOJ正進一步擺脫數十年的超低利率政策，不過與會的委員中7票贊成，2票則持反對意見，鴿派委員淺田統一郎和佐藤綾野反對將政策利率從1.00%上調至1.25%，他們都是由首相高市早苗所提名的，表明隨著BOJ政策委員會未來有更多委員更迭下，今後的加息恐將面臨更大的阻礙，儘管財政大臣片山皋月表示將與其他國家金融當局保持密切的溝通，並強調將毫不猶豫的進一步展開協調一致的外匯干預行動，但BOJ鷹派前景不如預期，日圓重挫，美元兌日圓自155.86低點走升。
隨後美國官方公布8月數據中，工業生產較前月持平，製造業產出月率也意外下降0.3%，凸顯油價利率雙漲，恐蓋過人工智能建設帶來的部分支撐，另外世界大型企業研究會公布美國8月領先指標亦下降0.1%，疲軟數據表現令美元承壓，與此同時，據日經新聞稱，日本官方進行匯率查詢，引發干預的恐慌，令美元兌日圓自158.05高點下挫。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.40-60，阻力於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)總裁布洛克指出中東衝突與人工智能(AI)熱潮正對物價構成上行壓力，政策制定者將面臨今年三次加息是否足以使通脹率回到2%-3%的目標區間，RBA再次就通脹和利率發出鷹派信號，投資人隨即將RBA於9月加息的概率上升至95%，提振澳幣走勢，帶動歐元兌美元脫離1.1454低點。

items.title: 風向要變了？對沖基金近一年多來首次看漲日元
items.title_en: Is the Wind Changing? Hedge Funds Turn Bullish on the Yen for the First Time in Over a Year
paras: 日本央行升息之際，對沖基金對日元的立場出現重大轉向，自2025年7月以來首次轉為淨多頭，顯示在美日兩國當局入市干預後，外匯市場情緒已明顯改變。
不過，日本央行最新政策訊號不如部分投資人預期鷹派，使剛轉向看漲日元的交易商立即面臨壓力。
根據美國商品期貨交易委員會（CFTC）上周五(18日)公布的數據，截至9月15日當周，槓桿交易商已全數回補先前建立的日元空頭部位，並開始轉向做多日元。
彭博彙整數據顯示，相關基金目前持有約2,510億日元（約16億美元）的日元多頭部位。這是自2025年7月以來，對沖基金首度對日元持淨看漲立場，反映投機資金對日元後市的看法出現明顯逆轉。
這波倉位調整發生在美日當局入市干預數周後。根據彭博先前報導，美國財政部長貝森特曾表示，美方參與日元干預屬於「象徵性」行動，並表態支持美國出口競爭力。官方行動及政策訊號，成為市場重新評估日元走勢的重要因素。
日銀訊號不夠鷹派
對沖基金完成多空立場轉換的時機相當微妙。聯準會與日本央行本周相繼調高利率，但日本央行對未來政策的表態，未能滿足部分市場參與者對持續升息的預期，導致日元在升息後反而走弱，也讓剛建立多頭部位的交易商陷入被動。
日元周五盤中一度下跌1.3%，隨後跌幅收窄，紐約尾盤報約156.80日元兌1美元。根據《日經新聞》報導，日本央行已向市場參與者詢問匯率水準。此類「匯率詢價」通常被市場視為官方可能出手干預的前兆，消息傳出後，日元跌勢隨即有所緩和。
美元多頭同步降溫
與此同時，包括資產管理機構及非商業交易商在內的投機性交易人，截至9月15日已將美元淨多頭部位降至3月以來最低水準，顯示市場先前不僅提高對日元的看漲押注，也同步降低對美元的多頭布局。
然而，美元本周隨後強勢反彈，單周漲幅創下近三個月最大，使先前減持美元的交易商同樣承受壓力。日元多頭增加、美元多頭降溫，與本周實際匯率走勢形成落差，凸顯央行政策訊號仍主導短線外匯市場。
CFTC持倉數據提供市場觀察外匯交易情緒的重要窗口，反映對沖基金與資產管理機構透過衍生性金融商品建立的整體部位方向。
目前全球外匯市場日均成交規模達9.5兆美元，日元能否延續看漲氣氛，仍取決於日本央行後續升息訊號及官方是否進一步干預匯市。
paras_en: As the Bank of Japan raises rates, hedge funds have made a major shift in their yen stance, moving to a net long position for the first time since July 2025, indicating that forex market sentiment has clearly changed after interventions by U.S. and Japanese authorities.
However, the latest policy signals from the BOJ are less hawkish than some investors expected, putting immediate pressure on traders who have just turned bullish on the yen.

According to data released by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) on Friday the 18th, by the week ending September 15 leveraged traders had fully covered their previously established short yen positions and begun to go long the currency.

Bloomberg’s compiled data show that the relevant funds now hold about ¥251 billion (roughly $1.6 billion) of long yen positions. This is the first net‑bullish stance on the yen by hedge funds since July 2025, reflecting a clear reversal in speculative sentiment toward the currency’s outlook.

The position adjustment comes weeks after U.S. and Japanese authorities stepped into the market. Bloomberg previously reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen described the U.S. side of the yen intervention as a “symbolic” action and voiced support for U.S. export competitiveness. Official actions and policy signals have become key factors in the market’s reassessment of yen direction.
BOJ signals not hawkish enough

The timing of hedge funds’ long‑short switch is delicate. The Fed and the BOJ both raised rates this week, but the BOJ’s forward guidance failed to meet some market participants’ expectations for continued tightening, causing the yen to weaken after the rate hike and leaving newly‑long traders on the back foot.

The yen fell as much as 1.3% intraday on Friday before narrowing its loss, closing the New York session around ¥156.80 per $1. According to the Nikkei, the BOJ has queried market participants on exchange‑rate levels – a “rate inquiry” that markets usually interpret as a possible precursor to official intervention, which tempered the yen’s decline when the news broke.
Dollar bulls cool off

At the same time, speculative traders, including asset managers and non‑commercial participants, had reduced their net long dollar positions to the lowest level since March as of September 15, showing that the market not only increased its bullish bets on the yen but also scaled back its long dollar exposure.

Nevertheless, the dollar rebounded strongly later in the week, posting its biggest weekly gain in nearly three months, putting pressure on traders who had trimmed dollar exposure. The rise in yen longs and the cooling of dollar longs contrast with the week’s actual exchange‑rate moves, underscoring that central‑bank signals still dominate short‑term forex dynamics.
CFTC position data provide an important window into forex‑trading sentiment, reflecting the overall directional bias of hedge funds and asset managers through derivative instruments.

The global forex market now sees a daily turnover of about $9.5 trillion. Whether the yen can sustain its bullish momentum will still depend on the BOJ’s future rate‑hike signals and whether officials step up intervention in the currency market.

items.title: 輝達加持的AI新創Nscale申請上市！上半年營收暴增12.5倍仍虧損逾10億美元
items.title_en: Nvidia-Backed AI Startup Nscale Files for IPO! H1 Revenue Surges 12.5‑Fold Yet Losses Exceed $1 Billion
paras: 獲輝達(NVDA-US)投資、專注人工智慧(AI)模型基礎設施的雲端服務商Nscale，周五(18日)已向紐約證券交易所(NYSE)申請上市，股票代號為「NSCL」。
根據Nscale首次公開發行(IPO)說明書，在截至今年6月30日的六個月內期間，營收為1.406億美元，淨虧損達10.2億美元。相比之下，去年同期淨損為3.689億美元，營收僅1040萬美元，代表營收較去年同期暴增1252%。
Nscale並透露，目前為止的剩餘履約義務(RPO)達564億美元。
對手包括亞馬遜、CoreWeave
Nscale的競爭對手包括市場領先的雲端服務商亞馬遜(AMZN-US)，以及CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)等被稱為「新雲」(neocloud)的新一代供應商。
自2022年ChatGPT推出以來，OpenAI、Anthropic等AI實驗室對運算能力的需求似乎永無止境。因此，Anthropic與OpenAI都需要大量現金支付算力費用，兩家公司也都計劃上市。
這兩家AI實驗室都已與Nscale達成交易，由Nscale出租輝達圖形處理器(GPU)，供AI模型訓練與運行使用。
本身也是雲端服務商的微軟(MSFT-US)也已與Nscale簽約。Nscale表示，2026年上半年有一家未具名客戶貢獻超過一半營收。
尋求分散客戶、靠收購擴大AI服務
Nscale近來也試圖分散業務來源，目前已開始提供多款AI模型的推理服務。此外，7月還宣布計劃收購協助建構AI模型的新創軟體公司Anyscale。
Nscale上周宣布，曾任OpenAI、Instacart(CART-US)與Meta(META-US)高層的Fidji Simo加入董事會。其他董事會成員還包括Meta前高層Nick Clegg與桑柏格(Sheryl Sandberg)。
### 手握46.1萬顆GPU合約　但負債逾80億美元
截至8月31日，Nscale擁有2.5萬顆啟用中的GPU，若加入已啟用或已簽約的GPU，總數達46.1萬顆。公司目前擁有五座已啟用、12座已簽約的資料中心據點。
Nscale表示目前已掌握相當於10GW的運算能力，負債則超過80億美元，這個金額還沒把與AI伺服器製造商戴爾(DELL-US)的融資計畫算進來。
Nscale總部位於倫敦，截至8月31日擁有逾1000名全職員工。該公司於2024年結束神秘模式，從加密貨幣挖礦公司Arkon Energy分拆成立，投資人包括Blue Owl、戴爾、輝達、Fidelity與Point72。
Nscale今年3月表示，在其中一輪募資中，投資人對公司的估值達146億美元。
根據Nscale向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)提交的文件，輝達同意為Nscale在德州一項資料中心租賃協議下最高8.6億美元的義務提供擔保。
paras_en: Nscale, a cloud‑service provider focused on AI model infrastructure and backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US), filed on Friday (the 18th) for a listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker "NSCL".

According to Nscale’s prospectus, revenue for the six‑month period ending June 30 this year was $140.6 million, while net loss reached $1.02 billion. By contrast, the same period last year saw a net loss of $368.9 million and revenue of only $10.4 million, meaning revenue jumped 1,252% year‑over‑year.
Nscale disclosed that its remaining performance obligations (RPO) to date total $56.4 billion.
Competitors include Amazon and CoreWeave.
Nscale’s rivals comprise market‑leading cloud provider Amazon (AMZN‑US) as well as next‑generation “neocloud” suppliers such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) and Nebius (NBIS‑US).

Since the launch of ChatGPT in 2022, AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic have shown seemingly endless demand for compute power. Consequently, both Anthropic and OpenAI need massive cash to pay for compute and are planning IPOs themselves.
Both AI labs have struck deals with Nscale, which rents Nvidia graphics processing units (GPUs) to them for training and running AI models.
Microsoft (MSFT‑US), also a cloud provider, has signed a contract with Nscale. Nscale said an unnamed customer contributed more than half of its revenue in the first half of 2026.
Seeking to diversify its customer base and grow AI services through acquisitions

Nscale has recently been trying to diversify its revenue sources; it has begun offering inference services for a variety of AI models and announced in July a plan to acquire the AI‑model‑building startup Anyscale.

Last week Nscale announced that Fidji Simo, a former senior executive at OpenAI, Instacart (CART‑US) and Meta (META‑US), has joined its board. Other board members include former Meta executive Nick Clegg and Sheryl Sandberg.
### Holding contracts for 461,000 GPUs but debt exceeds $8 billion

As of August 31, Nscale operated 25,000 active GPUs; counting GPUs already activated or under contract brings the total to 461,000. The company currently runs five active data‑center sites and has contracts for twelve additional sites.
Nscale says it now controls roughly 10 GW of compute capacity, while its debt tops $8 billion, not including financing arrangements with AI‑server maker Dell (DELL‑US).

Nscale is headquartered in London and had more than 1,000 full‑time employees as of August 31. The company emerged from “stealth mode” in 2024, spinning out of cryptocurrency miner Arkon Energy, with investors such as Blue Owl, Dell, Nvidia, Fidelity and Point72.
In March this year Nscale disclosed that a financing round valued the company at $14.6 billion.
SEC filings show that Nvidia has agreed to provide a guarantee of up to $860 million for Nscale’s Texas data‑center lease obligations.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元維持逾7周高點 Fed立場偏鷹
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Holds Over 7‑Week High as Fed Takes Hawkish Stance
paras: 美元周五(18日)走弱，但在美國聯準會(Fed)升息提振下，本周創3個月來最佳單周表現。同時，市場焦點轉向日元走弱。日本銀行(BoJ)將利率升至31年高點，但市場認為升息幅度及後續政策訊號不夠強硬，導致日元走跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.1%，報100.22。本周上漲約1.1%，創6月中旬以來最佳單周表現。
本周市場焦點集中在央行升息。聯準會公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率由3.50%至3.75%上調至3.75%至4.00%。此外，更新後的「經濟預測摘要」，以及聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後的記者會，都釋放出明顯偏鷹訊號。
在FOMC公布決策前，市場對聯準會升息的預期機率一度飆升至90%，主要受到油價飆升、美國經濟數據，以及債券市場持續遭拋售等因素推動。
固定收益投資人尤其對升息決定表示肯定，認為這顯示聯準會並未落後於通膨走勢，進而推動美國公債殖利率周四上升。不過，殖利率周五再度走高，其中10年期美債殖利率最新上升6.1個基點至5.008%。本周稍早，該殖利率一度飆升至逾19年高點。
Interactive Brokers的Torres表示，最新一波美債殖利率上升，與日元走跌有關。
他表示，「日元貶值對美國公債形成阻力，因東京是美國公債最大的海外持有者。日元走弱會逐步迫使日本當局出售美國公債，以籌措現金干預外匯市場，進而支撐日元匯率。」
日銀被認為不夠鷹派
日銀將基準政策利率上調25個基點至1.25%。這項升息符合市場普遍預期，當前日本正面臨日元疲弱與能源成本飆升的雙重壓力。
一般而言，利率走高往往有利於貨幣升值。然而，此次升息並未帶動日本資產上漲，反而觸發外匯交易市場一波獲利了結。投資人原本期待日銀採取更積極升息策略，但兩名審議委員對此次升息持異議，投票主張維持利率不變，令央行的鷹派立場有所軟化，也降低市場對後續快速緊縮的預期。
日銀總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在決策公布後表示，此次行動是為了提前因應，以避免日後被迫採取劇烈措施，但他也強調，日銀並未考慮採取激進的貨幣政策衝擊療法。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「儘管植田表示，若有需要，他將支持進一步升息，但兩名政策制定者反對昨日的升息決定，使部分投資人開始質疑，如果通膨未能降溫，日銀是否有決心積極收緊貨幣政策，這也導致日元兌美元跌至兩周低點。」
周五稍晚，日元一度大幅收復部分跌幅。因《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已進行所謂的利率檢查，即聯絡外匯市場參與者，詢問目前的匯率水準。市場通常將利率檢查視為潛在外匯干預前的初步行動。
今年以來，日本當局已投入超過15兆日元(約957億美元)支撐日元匯率。
日元周五一度跌至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後收復部分跌幅，最高回升至155.88。本周創下2025年10月以來最差單周表現。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Friday (the 18th), but boosted by the Federal Reserve’s rate hike it delivered its best weekly performance in three months this week. Meanwhile, market focus shifted to the weakening yen. The Bank of Japan raised rates to a 31‑year high, but markets judged the size of the hike and subsequent policy signals as insufficiently aggressive, sending the yen lower.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.1% to 100.22. The index is up about 1.1% for the week, marking its strongest weekly gain since mid‑June.

The week’s market focus centered on central‑bank rate hikes. The Federal Open Market Committee voted unanimously on Wednesday to raise the federal funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%. In addition, the updated Summary of Economic Projections and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s post‑decision press conference both conveyed a clearly hawkish tone.
Ahead of the FOMC announcement, market expectations for a Fed hike briefly spiked to 90%, driven mainly by soaring oil prices, U.S. economic data and continued bond‑market selling pressure.

Fixed‑income investors welcomed the rate‑hike decision, seeing it as evidence that the Fed is not lagging behind inflation, which pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher on Thursday. However, yields rose again on Friday, with the 10‑year Treasury yield climbing 6.1 basis points to 5.008%. Earlier in the week the yield had surged to a 19‑year high.
Torres of Interactive Brokers said the latest wave of Treasury‑yield gains is linked to the yen’s decline.

He explained, “A weaker yen creates resistance for U.S. Treasuries because Tokyo is the largest overseas holder of U.S. government debt. A falling yen will gradually force Japanese authorities to sell Treasuries to raise cash for foreign‑exchange intervention, thereby supporting the yen.”
The Bank of Japan is seen as insufficiently hawkish
The BOJ lifted its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%. The move was broadly expected as Japan faces a double squeeze of a weak yen and soaring energy costs.

Generally, higher rates tend to support currency appreciation. This time, however, the hike did not lift Japanese assets and instead sparked profit‑taking in the FX market. Investors had hoped the BOJ would adopt a more aggressive tightening path, but two board members opposed the move, voting to keep rates unchanged, which softened the central bank’s hawkish stance and lowered expectations for rapid further tightening.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said after the decision that the action was taken pre‑emptively to avoid having to resort to drastic measures later, but he stressed the bank has not considered adopting an aggressive monetary‑policy shock approach.

Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers noted, “Even though Governor Ueda said he would support further hikes if needed, the opposition of two policymakers to yesterday’s hike has led some investors to question whether the BOJ is truly committed to aggressive tightening if inflation does not cool, contributing to the yen’s slide to a two‑week low against the dollar.”

Later on Friday, the yen briefly reclaimed part of its losses after the Nikkei reported that the BOJ had conducted a so‑called rate check – contacting FX market participants to gauge current exchange‑rate levels. Markets usually view a rate check as a preliminary step before possible foreign‑exchange intervention.
Since the start of the year, Japanese authorities have deployed more than ¥15 trillion (about $95.7 billion) to support the yen.
The yen fell to ¥158.05 per dollar on Friday before partially recovering, climbing back up to a high of ¥155.88. The week marked its worst performance since October 2025.

items.title: 日銀升息也救不了日元？跌近158後傳出詢價 市場緊盯干預
items.title_en: Can BOJ Rate Hikes Still Not Save the Yen? After Falling Near 158, a Quote Request Sparks Market Watch for Intervention
paras: 日元周五(18日)在日本央行升息後一度重貶，跌至接近1美元兌158日元，但《日本經濟新聞》報導，日本央行向市場人士詢問匯率水準後，日元跌幅收斂。市場通常將這類「匯率詢價」視為官方可能干預匯市的前兆，但目前尚無當局實際進場的消息。
紐約時間下午1時20分左右，日元報1美元兌156.70日元，仍貶值0.5%，但已收復盤中最多1.3%的跌幅。《日本經濟新聞》未說明消息來源；日本財務省在非辦公時間也未能立即回應置評要求。
日本央行稍早如預期升息，但總裁植田和男對後續升息路徑的說法未能滿足市場偏鷹派的期待。他表示，貨幣政策已進入新階段，但目前難以判定本輪升息的最終利率。此外，兩名決策委員對升息投下反對票，增添未來升息速度與幅度的不確定性。
美國銀行匯率策略師Alex Cohen指出，日銀才剛升息，日元卻仍急貶，這次詢價形同再向市場發出警告。日本財務省先前已展現動用大量外匯存底干預的意願，押注日元續貶的交易員不能忽視這項訊號。
日元7月曾跌至約1美元兌164日元，創40年低點，隨後美日聯手買進日元，為1998年以來首見。日本財務省數據顯示，截至8月26日的一個月內，日本干預匯市支出達創紀錄的15.4兆日元。如今日本進入連續假期，交易量較低，任何官方行動都可能放大短線波動。
不過，日元仍面臨美日利差壓力。聯準會(Fed)重啟升息，可能削弱日銀升息對日元的支撐，讓借入低息日元、投資高收益資產的交易持續具有吸引力。匯市干預或許能迅速打擊押注日元貶值的部位，但能否扭轉長期走勢，仍取決於兩國貨幣政策的變化。
paras_en: The yen briefly slumped on Friday (the 18th) after the Bank of Japan raised rates, dropping to near ¥158 per $1, but after the BOJ queried market participants about the exchange‑rate level, the yen’s decline narrowed. Such “rate quotes” are usually seen as a pre‑signal that officials may step into the FX market, though no concrete intervention has been reported yet.

Around 1:20 p.m. New York time, the yen was quoted at ¥156.70 per $1, still down 0.5% but having recovered most of the intra‑day 1.3% fall. The Nikkei did not disclose its source; the Ministry of Finance, out of office, did not immediately respond to comment requests.

The BOJ earlier this week raised rates as expected, but Governor Kazuo Ueda’s comments on the future tightening path fell short of the market’s hawkish hopes. He said monetary policy has entered a new stage but it is still too early to determine the final rate for this round. Moreover, two policy‑board members voted against the hike, adding uncertainty to the pace and magnitude of future tightening.

Bank of America FX strategist Alex Cohen noted that the BOJ just raised rates yet the yen is still sharply weakening, and this quote request is essentially another warning to the market. The Ministry of Finance has previously shown willingness to use large foreign‑exchange reserves for intervention, a signal that traders betting on further yen depreciation cannot ignore.

The yen fell to about ¥164 per $1 in July, a 40‑year low, before the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen – the first such coordinated action since 1998. Ministry data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan’s FX‑market intervention spending hit a record ¥15.4 trillion. With Japan now on a consecutive holiday and trading volume low, any official move could amplify short‑term volatility.

Nevertheless, the yen remains under pressure from the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differential. The Fed’s renewed rate hikes could blunt the BOJ’s rate‑rise support for the yen, keeping the carry‑trade of borrowing cheap yen to invest in higher‑yield assets attractive. Intervention may quickly hit positions betting on yen weakness, but whether it can reverse the longer‑term trend still depends on the evolution of both countries’ monetary policies.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢回流股匯雙漲 爆量走升收31.808元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar: Hot Money Returns, Stocks and Exchange Rate Rise, Volume Surges, Closing at 31.808
paras: 美國升息 1 碼，不確定因素消除，在熱錢回流下，台北股匯今 (18) 日連袂走揚，新台幣兌美元一度強升 1.5 角，終場升幅收斂，收在 31.808 元，升值 7.3 分，台北及元太外匯市場總成交值爆出 39.9 億美元。
新台幣兌美元今天以 31.86 元開盤後，在熱錢狂湧下，一度升抵 31.722 元，但日本央行決議升息，日元應聲走貶，加上央行全力防守，使得新台幣升幅明顯收斂，終場收在 31.808 元，升值 7.3 分，匯價連二升。
本周受到升息預期影響，美元表現強勢，新台幣兌美元本周累計貶值 1.7 角、貶幅 0.53%，周線連三黑。
在美股強力反彈下，台股今天持續走揚，台積電、聯發科、聯電、日月光投控等電子權值股普遍走高，大盤終場勁揚 892.75 點，收在 47180.75 點，成功站上 4 萬 7，外資買超 869 億元，上市公司總市值回升至 154.32 兆元。

paras_en: U.S. rate hikes by one percentage point removed uncertainties, and with hot‑money inflows, Taipei’s stock and foreign‑exchange markets both rose on the 18th. The New Taiwan dollar briefly surged 0.15 NTD per USD before the gain narrowed, closing at 31.808 NTD, up 0.073 NTD, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai FX markets exploded to $3.99 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.86 per USD and, amid a flood of hot money, climbed to 31.722. However, the Bank of Japan’s decision to raise rates caused the yen to depreciate, and the central bank’s vigorous defense curbed the NT$’s rise. It finished at 31.808 NTD, up 0.073 NTD, marking a second consecutive session of appreciation.
This week, expectations of further rate hikes kept the dollar strong. The New Taiwan dollar depreciated against the USD by 0.17 NTD (0.53%) for the week, delivering a third straight weekly decline.

With a strong rebound in U.S. equities, Taiwan’s market kept climbing today. Major chip stocks such as TSMC, MediaTek, UMC and ASE Technology Holding all rose, and the index surged 892.75 points to close at 47,180.75, breaking the 47,000 level. Foreign investors net bought NT$86.9 billion, and the total market capitalization of listed companies recovered to NT$154.32 trillion.
